title: Joint Model-independent Constraints on the Post-Newtonian Parameter and Cosmic Curvature from Galaxy-scale Strong Lensing, SNe Ia, BAO, and Cosmic Chronometers
background_knowledge: 广义相对论（GR）是现代宇宙学的标准引力理论，但其在星系及更大尺度上的有效性仍需严格的观测检验。参数化后牛顿（PPN）形式中的参数 \gamma_{PPN} 是衡量空间曲率产生的引力偏折程度的关键指标，在GR框架内其理论严格为1。星系尺度的强引力透镜（SGL）效应是限制 \gamma_{PPN} 的有力工具。然而，利用宇宙学探针测试引力理论时常面临“逻辑循环问题”（Circularity Problem），即在推导透镜系统的宇宙学距离时，往往已经预设了基于GR的特定宇宙学模型（如 \Lambda CDM）。为打破这一循环，研究者常采用弗里德曼-勒梅特-罗伯逊-沃尔克（FLRW）度规下的“距离和规则”（Distance Sum Rule），结合Ia型超新星（SNe Ia）、重子声学振荡（BAO）和宇宙计时器（CC）等标准烛光或标准尺，来实现对引力理论和宇宙空间曲率（\Omega_k）的无模型（Model-independent）独立约束。
contribution: 本研究结合星系尺度强引力透镜（SGL）与SNe Ia、BAO及宇宙计时器，在千秒差距尺度上对广义相对论进行了无模型的严格检验。研究引入了两项重要的方法学改进：1）利用二阶切比雪夫正交多项式参数化暗能量演化因子，在全红移基线上保证高收敛性的同时，将空间曲率 \Omega_k 保留为显式的自由参数；2）将原有的双探针扩展为四探针联合分析。结果显示，在68%置信度下，\gamma_{PPN} = 1.119 \pm 0.072（在1.7\sigma 范围内与GR的理论预言一致），\Omega_k = 0.101 \pm 0.077（在2\sigma 范围内与平坦宇宙相符，略微倾向于开放宇宙）。此外，研究量化了8种典型暗能量模型引入的系统偏移，发现其远低于目前的1\sigma 统计误差，证明了传统强透镜引力测试中并未引入显著的系统性偏差，充分验证了该无模型框架的可靠性。
summary: This investigation aims to test the validity of general relativity (GR) on kiloparsec scales via galaxy-scale strong gravitational lensing (SGL) combined with multiple cosmological probes. To circumvent the circularity problem induced by the presumption of a cosmological model based on GR, we apply the distance sum rule in the Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) metric to constrain the post-Newtonian parameter gamma PPN and spatial curvature Omega k independently of any cosmological model. The study introduces two methodological improvements: (i) parameterizing the dark-energy evolution factor with second-order Chebyshev orthogonal polynomials, which ensures uniformly high convergence across the full redshift baseline while retaining Omega k as an explicit free parameter; (ii) extending the original two-probe configuration (SGL + Type Ia supernovae) to a four-probe joint analysis that includes baryon acoustic oscillations and cosmic chronometers. Our results show that gamma PPN = 1.119 (+0.072/-0.072) and Omega k = 0.101 (+0.077/-0.076) at 68% confidence. The gamma PPN value is consistent with the GR prediction of unity at 1.7 sigma, while Omega k favors a mildly open universe, with flatness consistent at 2 sigma. Taking model-independent constraints as a benchmark, we quantify the systematic shift in gamma PPN induced by eight representative dark energy models, and find that all offsets are negligible, well below the baseline 1 sigma uncertainty, with no significant bias at current precision. These results confirm that conventional strong-lensing gravity tests introduce no measurable systematic bias, validating our model-independent framework.

title: South Pole-Aitken basin sample Return and eXploration (SPARX) Science Definition Team Report
background_knowledge: 行星科学与月球探测领域长期致力于理解太阳系早期的撞击历史、类地行星的形成演化以及月球的内部结构。月球南极-艾特肯（South Pole-Aitken, SPA）盆地是月球背面已知最大、最深、最古老的撞击盆地。由于其特殊的尺寸与古老地质年龄，该盆地极可能暴露了月球深部地壳甚至月幔物质，并保留了太阳系早期频繁撞击事件的原始记录。过去二十多年来，历次美国行星科学十年调查（Decadal Survey）均将SPA盆地采样返回任务列为最高优先级的月球科学任务，因为它能为验证长达半个多世纪的月球演化假说提供无可替代的实地样本。
contribution: 本报告（SPARX）受NASA委托，针对月球南极-艾特肯盆地采样返回任务，系统性地分析并提出了优先科学目标、测量要求、实施架构以及设计参考任务。该报告充分结合了远程表面探测技术和美国商业航天产业的最新进展，旨在解答多项十年调查中的核心科学问题，并提出了一种融合机器人与人类探测、更具成本效益的21世纪行星表面探测新范式。
summary: Sample return from South Pole-Aitken Basin (SPA) on the Moon has been recognized as the highest priority lunar science mission for well over two decades, appearing as a recommended New Frontiers class mission in the two previous Planetary Science Decadal Survey documents (2003-2012 New Frontiers, 2013-2022 Visions and Voyages), and as a prioritized mission for the Lunar Discovery and Exploration Program (LDEP) in the 2023-2032 Origins, Worlds, and Life Decadal Survey. The South Pole-Aitken basin presents the ideal target destination to test nearly 60 years of lunar science hypotheses owing to a unique combination of its size, antiquity, and location on the lunar farside. Convened by NASA in response to OWL Decadal Survey recommendations, the SPARX report provides analysis on prioritized science objectives, measurement requirements, implementation architectures, and a design reference mission for a South Pole-Aitken basin sample return mission. The mission profiles presented in this report leverage key advancements in remote surface exploration technology, the U.S. commercial space industry, and the programmatic focus on sustained human presence and exploration at the lunar south polar region. The science objectives and measurements presented in this report outline a mission that would transform lunar science, would address multiple high-level Decadal science questions at the only place in the Solar System where they can be credibly addressed, would pioneer a new paradigm for planetary surface exploration in the 21st century, would leverage the burgeoning space economy to pursue ground-breaking science on a more cost-efficient basis, and would unite robotic exploration with human exploration in a model for a future sustained lunar enterprise.

title: Differential Double Blind Fourier Holography (diff-DBFH)
background_knowledge: 高性能光学系统（特别是大型空间望远镜）为了达到接近衍射极限的超高分辨率，必须具备高精度的波前传感与校正能力，以补偿系统内部的光学畸变和对准误差。传统的波前传感技术通常需要专用的干涉或硬件设备（如夏克-哈特曼波前传感器），或者依赖于计算量庞大的非线性或迭代相位恢复算法。焦平面波前传感技术（Focal-plane wavefront-sensing）由于不需要增加额外的测量硬件，且能消除非共光路像差，近年来备受青睐。在众多焦平面方法中，双盲傅里叶全息术（DBFH）作为一种稳健且计算量小的非迭代替代方案，在波前重建领域展现出了显著的优势。
contribution: 本文提出了一种新型的波前传感方法——差分双盲傅里叶全息术（diff-DBFH）。该方法是DBFH的双图像变体，基于微小的光瞳面振幅微扰来实现。受差分光学传递函数（dOTF）的启发，diff-DBFH利用DBFH的线性数学框架来生成更高精度的波前估计。研究团队推导了diff-DBFH的理论公式，并在受‘宜居世界天文台’（Habitable Worlds Observatory）启发的拼接镜面模型上进行了数值模拟，比较了其与dOTF的性能表现及在噪声条件下的灵敏度。最终，作者利用相同孔径的光学平台实验模型，成功对该方法进行了实验验证。
summary: High-performance optical systems, including space telescopes, require wavefront-sensing and correction capabilities to achieve resolution near the diffraction limit. Existing wavefront-sensing approaches span a broad range of architectures, but many require dedicated interferometric hardware, rely on computationally intensive nonlinear or iterative reconstruction algorithms or provide only limited wavefront information. Focal-plane wavefront-sensing methods are particularly attractive because they can operate without dedicated metrology hardware, and among these, Double Blind Fourier Holography (DBFH) stands out as a robust and computationally light alternative to nonlinear and iterative solvers. Here we introduce differential Double Blind Fourier Holography (diff-DBFH), a two-image variant of DBFH based on a small pupil-plane amplitude perturbation. Inspired by differential Optical Transfer Function (dOTF), diff-DBFH leverages the linear framework of DBFH to produce a more precise wavefront estimate. We derive the diff-DBFH formalism, compare its performance against dOTF using numerical simulations on a segmented aperture geometry inspired by the Habitable Worlds Observatory, analyze its sensitivity under noisy conditions, and demonstrate the method experimentally using an optical bench model of the same aperture.

title: PAHSPECS: JWST/MIRI Spectroscopy of PAHs at Cosmic Noon
background_knowledge: 多环芳烃（PAHs）是星系星际介质（ISM）的重要组成部分，在大质量恒星周围的光解离区（PDRs）中，PAH分子吸收紫外光子并在中红外波段（如3.3、6.2、7.7、8.6和11.3微米）产生强烈的辐射特征，是调节星际气体加热和冷却过程的关键机制。红移z~1-2被称为“宇宙正午（Cosmic Noon）”，是宇宙历史上恒星形成活动最剧烈的时期。天文学家普遍认为该时期星系的星际介质物理条件与本地宇宙中的星系存在显著差异。然而，在詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）投入使用前，受限于红外望远镜的灵敏度与空间分辨率，人们无法对这一时期典型的主序星系进行高质量的PAH光谱观测，这极大地限制了我们对早期星系热力学与化学平衡演化的认知。
contribution: 本文发布了PAHSPECS项目，这是首个利用JWST MIRI/MRS设备对红移z~1主序星系进行多波段PAH特征光谱巡天的研究。作者探测了5个目标星系，发现宽带中红外测光SED拟合能准确还原6.2和7.7 μm的PAH光度，但会显著高估3.3和11.3 μm的特征光度（达50%甚至3-5倍）。通过IFU光谱的空间分辨映射，研究证实了必须依赖光谱学才能准确分析PAH比值的空间变化及尘埃性质。此外，与近邻系统相比，宇宙正午星系的6.2 μm等值宽度存在超出，而3.3 μm等值宽度偏低，这揭示了在此时期星系中，中性与电离态PAH分子的尺寸分布发生了差异性的演化。
summary: The physical conditions of the interstellar medium (ISM) are thought to differ greatly at high redshifts compared to local galaxies. Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are key ISM constituents, mediating the heating and cooling of gas in photo-dissociation regions. However, PAHs are unexplored in main-sequence (MS) galaxies at z~1-2 (cosmic noon), limiting our view of the ISM's thermal and chemical balance. We present the PAH Spectroscopic Survey (PAHSPECS) JWST program, the first MIRI/MRS survey of the 3.3, 6.2, 7.7, 8.6 and 11.3$μ$m PAH features in MS galaxies at z~1. The five targets come from the deep ALMA CO and continuum flux-limited sample in the HUDF. We detect the 6.2, 7.7 and 11.3$μ$m PAHs in all galaxies, and the 3.3$μ$m feature in only two. Spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting to broad-band mid-IR photometry recovers the 6.2 and 7.7$μ$m PAH luminosities derived from spectral decomposition of the MRS spectra to within ~25% accuracy. However, the 3.3 and 11.3$μ$m features are overestimated by ~50% (up to 3-5x). Spatially resolved maps of ASPECS-6, the most extended source, show variations of the 7.7$μ$m PAH contribution to the MIRI F1500W flux, suggesting that while photometry can infer PAH luminosity accurately, IFU spectroscopy is necessary to study variations in PAH ratios and characterize galaxy dust properties. The PAH fraction of the total dust mass from photometric SED modeling roughly agrees with the $L_{\rm PAH}/L_{\rm IR}$ ratio measured from spectroscopy, but the correlation is not as tight as models predict. On average, PAHSPECS galaxies show an excess in 6.2$μ$m equivalent width relative to nearby dusty luminous systems, but lower 3.3$μ$m equivalent widths than local systems, similar to higher-mass starbursts at z~1-3. This points to differential changes in the size distributions of neutral and ionized PAHs in cosmic noon galaxies.

title: Discovery of an isolated RELHIC Candidate: J1351+0039
background_knowledge: 在冷暗物质（CDM）宇宙学标准模型中，宇宙大尺度结构的形成伴随着大量低质量暗物质晕的产生。然而，在宇宙再电离时期，强烈的紫外背景辐射加热了星系际介质，导致在这些浅引力势阱中，气体无法有效冷却并坍缩形成恒星。这类仅包含暗物质和中性氢（HI）气体而无恒星形成的系统被称为“再电离受限中性氢云”（RELHICs），即理论预言中的“暗星系”。由于缺乏恒星发出的光学辐射，寻找这些天体极其困难，主要依赖于射电望远镜在21厘米波段对中性氢辐射的盲搜。这些“暗星系”是检验冷暗物质模型、研究极端低质量尺度下暗物质与重子相互作用以及星系形成截断机制的关键天然实验室。
contribution: 利用500米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST）的中性氢盲搜数据与DESI巡天的深度光学图像，发现了一个新的孤立暗星系候选体J1351+0039。该天体具有致密的中性氢结构（推算HI质量为4.8×10^5太阳质量），且无光学对应体（恒星质量上限仅为1.5×10^5太阳质量）。其动力学质量估计为1.3×10^8太阳质量，暗物质与重子质量比高达200，表明其被暗物质极端主导。其运动学特征由内部速度弥散（压强支撑）主导，高度契合RELHICs的理论预言。J1351+0039是目前最具潜力的孤立RELHIC候选体之一，为在无恒星形成干扰的环境下研究重子物理与暗物质提供了极为独特的观测样本。
summary: We report the discovery of J1351+0039, a new isolated dark galaxy candidate identified through a blind HI survey with the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST), combined with deep optical imaging from the DESI Legacy Survey. The object displays a compact HI structure with a systemic velocity of V_{LSR} = 429.0 \kms and an inferred HI mass of 4.8*10^5 Msun. No optical counterpart is detected in the DESI images, with a g-band surface brightness limit of 28.1 mag arcsec^{-2}, corresponding to a stellar mass limit of M_{star} of 1.5*10^{5} Msun. The dynamical mass is estimated to be M_{dyn} of 1.3*10^{8} Msun, yielding a dark-to-baryonic mass ratio of 200, implying that J1351+0039 is overwhelmingly dominated by dark matter. While week rotation is detected in J1351+0039, the kinematics are dominated by internal velocity dispersion, confirming pressure support and reminiscent of Reionization-Limited HI Clouds (RELHICs). J1351+0039 stands out as one of the most promising isolated RELHIC candidates, offering a unique laboratory for studying baryonic physics and dark matter in the absence of star formation.

title: Plasma Effects Suppress Mixing-Induced Collisional Freeze-In
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙的高温致密环境中，暗物质可以通过与标准模型热等离子体中粒子的微弱混合而逐渐产生，这种机制被称为“冻结”（Freeze-in）。主要的产生途径包括振荡冻结（Oscillatory freeze-in）和碰撞冻结（Collisional freeze-in）。其中，惰性中微子（Sterile Neutrino）是这类暗物质的经典候选者。早期宇宙充满了等离子体，等离子体效应（如热浴中粒子的相互作用引起的有效质量和混合角改变）会显著影响这些微弱相互作用粒子的产生率。长期以来，物理学界已知等离子体效应会压制振荡冻结机制，但其对碰撞冻结过程的定量影响一直缺乏清晰结论，导致在评估惰性中微子暗物质产生量时存在相互矛盾的研究结果。
contribution: 本文利用味协变表述下的第一性原理非平衡态 Kadanoff-Baym 方程，建立了一个普适结论：等离子体效应同样会显著压制碰撞冻结过程，即碰撞率中的真空混合角必须被等离子体修正后的混合角所替代。基于此理论结果，作者得出结论：若通过标准模型等离子体产生，质量在 keV 至 MeV 范围内的惰性中微子无法提供足够的丰度，因此不能作为暗物质。
summary: Dark matter that is weakly mixed with particles in a thermal plasma can be produced through both, oscillatory and collisional freeze-in. While plasma effects have long been known to suppress the former, their role in collisional freeze-in remains less clear quantitatively, leading to conflicting results in sterile neutrino dark matter production via collisional freeze-in. Using first-principles nonequilibrium Kadanoff-Baym equations in the flavour-covariant formulation, we establish the general result that plasma effects also suppress collisional freeze-in: the vacuum mixing angle in the collision rate is replaced by its plasma-corrected counterpart. Applying this result, we conclude that sterile neutrinos cannot be dark matter in the keV-MeV mass range when produced from the Standard Model plasma.

title: GIMLI: a toolkit connecting linear and non-linear magnetohydrodynamic regimes
background_knowledge: 磁流体力学（MHD）是天体物理和等离子体物理中研究导电流体与磁场相互作用的基本物理框架。在理论分析与数值模拟中，系统的演化通常涉及线性和非线性两个阶段：线性MHD理论（如微扰分析或谱方法）常用于计算系统的本征波动模式、不稳定性及其初始增长率；非线性MHD模拟（如使用自适应网格细化的大型计算代码）则用于追踪大尺度扰动的非线性演化、湍流级联发展及其最终的物理饱和状态。在实际研究中，将高精度的线性解作为非线性数值模拟的精确初始条件，是验证代码可靠性并深入理解天体等离子体复杂动力学过程（如日冕环动力学、磁场不稳定性演化）的关键研究范式。
contribution: 本文开发并介绍了一个名为GIMLI（MPI-AMRVAC与Legolas互连通用接口）的工具包，成功构建了线性与非线性磁流体力学（MHD）研究之间的桥梁。该工具连接了线性MHD谱分析代码（Legolas）与非线性模拟代码（MPI-AMRVAC），能够便捷地利用线性解来初始化非线性数值模拟。研究团队在笛卡尔和圆柱坐标系下，通过帕克不稳定的磁化大气、托卡马克装置中的交换模、电阻Harris电流片演化，以及日冕环中受热力学修正的离散阿尔芬波等典型等离子体和天体物理场景展示了该工具的强大功能，并为如何有效结合线性与非线性方法提供了实用建议。
summary: In this work, we present the General Interface for MPI-AMRVAC / Legolas Interconnection (or GIMLI, for short) as a toolkit for in-depth (magneto)hydrodynamic studies combining linear and non-linear methods. Acting as a bridge between the linear (M)HD spectroscopy code Legolas and the non-linear simulation code MPI-AMRVAC, GIMLI facilitates the initialization of non-linear MPI-AMRVAC simulations with linear solutions. We showcase this functionality on both Cartesian and cylindrical setups, covering representative plasma physical and astrophysical scenarios: Parker unstable magnetized atmospheres, interchange modes in a straight tokamak setup, resistive Harris sheet evolutions and thermally modified discrete Alfvén waves in coronal loops. We offer suggestions on how to combine linear and non-linear methods, and demonstrate how to leverage GIMLI in the process.

title: Probing the Metallicity Dependence of Fast Radio Burst Progenitors with CHIME/FRB Outrigger Dwarf Host Galaxies
background_knowledge: 快速射电暴（Fast Radio Burst, FRB）是宇宙中持续仅数毫秒的极强射电闪耀现象，其物理起源是现代天体物理学的重大未解之谜之一。观测上，FRB主要被分为重复暴（多次爆发）和非重复暴（单次爆发）两类。磁星（具有超强磁场的年轻中子星）被认为是FRB最有可能的前身星候选体。大质量恒星的演化及其最终坍缩形成中子星的过程，高度依赖于其诞生环境的气体金属丰度。例如，低金属丰度环境下的恒星往往能保留更多角动量，从而可能孕育出初始自转极快的磁星。通过探测和分析FRB宿主星系的物理性质（如恒星质量和金属丰度），天文学家可以间接推断FRB前身星的形成环境与演化历史。
contribution: 本研究利用CHIME/FRB Outriggers新定位的数据，系统搜寻并表征了8个FRB（1个重复暴，7个非重复暴）的宿主星系，其中5个被新分类为矮星系。研究首次发现重复暴与非重复暴的宿主星系在气体金属丰度分布上存在统计学上的显著差异：非重复暴普遍处于相对富金属的环境中，而重复暴显著偏好贫金属的矮星系。特别是伴有持续射电源（PRS）的重复暴，其环境金属丰度极低。此外，研究发现宿主星系的金属丰度与色散量（DM）、法拉第旋转量（RM）及散射时标均无显著相关性。该发现表明，这两类FRB的宿主金属丰度差异可能反映了依赖于金属丰度的大质量恒星演化机制，相较于非重复暴，重复暴及PRS的形成可能需要更为极端的磁星初始自转条件。
summary: Using the fast radio bursts (FRBs) localized with the CHIME/FRB Outriggers between February and October 2025, we conduct a systematic search for dwarf host galaxies. We identify and characterize eight host galaxies for one repeating and seven apparently non-repeating FRBs, newly classifying five hosts as dwarfs with stellar masses of $\log(M_\ast/M_\odot) \approx 8.1-9.1$. We measure their gas-phase metallicities and, when combined with hosts from the literature, finding that repeating and non-repeating FRBs have statistically distinct metallicity distributions. Non-repeating FRBs inhabit relatively metal-rich environments ($12 + \rm log( O/H) \gtrsim 8.35$) across the full observed mass range, while repeating FRBs have significant preference for dwarf galaxies with $12 + \rm log( O/H) \lesssim 8.35$. Almost all repeaters associated with persistent radio sources (PRSs) are in dwarfs with $12 + \rm log( O/H) \lesssim 8.15$, suggesting a connection between repeaters in metal-poor dwarf environments and PRS formation. We also calculate the host dispersion measure ($\mathrm{DM}_{\rm host}$), Faraday rotation measure ($\mathrm{RM}_{\rm host}$), and scattering timescale ($τ_{\rm host,1~GHz}$) for 54, 37, and 24 FRBs, respectively, including both our sample and FRBs in the literature. We find no significant ($>3σ$) correlation between host metallicity and $\mathrm{DM}_{\rm host}$, $\mathrm{RM}_{\rm host}$, or $τ_{\rm host,1~GHz}$. The distinct host metallicities of apparently non-repeating and repeating FRBs may reflect metallicity-dependent massive-star evolution, with repeating FRBs and PRSs requiring more extreme magnetar birth spins than the predominantly non-repeating FRB population.

title: Is MOND an Emergent Effective Law of a Complex Dark Matter Sector?
background_knowledge: 在现代天体物理与宇宙学中，冷暗物质主导的标准宇宙学模型（ΛCDM）在解释宇宙微波背景辐射、大尺度结构形成以及星系团动力学方面取得了巨大成功。然而，在较小的星系尺度上，纯粹的无碰撞冷暗物质模型在解释某些动力学观测时面临挑战。修正牛顿动力学（MOND）则是作为暗物质的替代理论被提出，它通过在极低加速度下修改牛顿定律，极为成功地唯象拟合了星系的平坦旋转曲线等小尺度动力学现象。但是，MOND在解释星系团尺度和宇宙学大尺度的观测时却面临严重困难。因此，学界一直在探讨能否将两者的优势结合，例如复杂的暗物质模型（如自相互作用暗物质）是否能在星系尺度上自然“涌现”出类似MOND的动力学行为。
contribution: 本文提出了一种理解MOND理论的新视角，即MOND并非星系尺度“缺失质量”问题的根本答案（无法取代暗物质），而是对暗物质在星系尺度下应有动力学行为的一种唯象描述。研究指出，这种星系尺度的MOND动力学可以通过具有尺度依赖特性的自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）来实现，这类暗物质会根据尺度和具体物理过程表现出无碰撞或有碰撞的特性。通过重申ΛCDM模型在宇宙学和星系团尺度的成功以及MOND在这些尺度的失效，作者排除了MOND作为全尺度普适基本规律的可能性，并得出结论：MOND仅仅是复杂暗物质区域在星系尺度上展现出的一种演生（Emergent）有效定律。
summary: In this work we aim to present a new perspective for MOND theory, namely that MOND theory is not an answer for the missing matter at galactic scales, but it provides a phenomenological description of the dynamics that DM should produce at galactic scales. We also aim to point out that MOND dynamics at galactic scales is achieved by scale-dependent self-interacting dark matter, which can behave as collisionless and collisional, depending on the scales and the physical processes. To this end, we first aim to highlight the successes of the $Λ$-Cold-Dark-Matter model and how it overwhelms over the MOND paradigm. Using textbook physics, we present the successes of the $Λ$-Cold-Dark-Matter at cosmological and cluster scales, and how these phenomena cannot be described consistently by MOND theories. Thus, by excluding MOND as being a viable description of nature at all scales, we conclude that MOND may not be the answer behind missing matter in Newtonian galactic dynamics, but it is just showing how the dynamics of dark matter should behave at galactic scales.

title: How Magnetic Fields Regulate Cooling and Mixing in Turbulent Radiative Mixing Layers
background_knowledge: 在天体物理中，当高温和低温气体相互发生相对运动时（如在日冕、星系风以及星系团的冷纤维状结构中），接触界面会产生剪切不稳定性并形成湍流辐射混合层（TRMLs）。这种多相气体的混合会引发高效的辐射冷却，对气体吸积、相变以及物质循环具有重要意义。尽管这些天体环境通常存在磁场，但过去的研究多集中于纯流体力学（HD）模型。磁场如何通过磁流体力学（MHD）效应（如磁张力）影响多相气体的湍流演化、混合效率及辐射冷却，是当前理解多相星际介质和星系周介质演化的关键前沿问题。
contribution: 本文利用高达1024×2048²分辨率的磁流体力学（MHD）模拟，系统研究了磁场对湍流辐射混合层的影响，涵盖了顺剪切方向、垂直剪切方向以及极性反转等多种磁场构型。研究发现：即使初始热相磁场较弱，磁张力也会显著削弱湍流运动，减少热气体向混合层的扩散及冷却界面的折叠，导致质量、焓通量和辐射冷却率比纯流体（HD）情况降低高达一个数量级。垂直磁场对冷却的抑制强于顺向磁场，而极性反转会改变冷却气体的形态但无法恢复至HD水平的混合效率。此外，MHD模型中的净冷却率随分辨率提高而持续下降且尚未收敛，表明所得的抑制因子仅为下限。该研究深刻揭示了磁场在调节多相气体冷却与混合中的主导作用。
summary: Turbulent radiative mixing layers (TRMLs) are expected wherever hot and cold gas move past one another, including in the solar corona, galactic winds, and cold filaments in galaxy clusters. These environments are often magnetized, but magnetic effects on mixing and cooling remain less well understood than in the hydrodynamic (HD) case. We present magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulations of TRMLs at resolutions up to $1024 \times 2048^2$, spanning fields aligned with and transverse to the shear, and polarity-reversing configurations in which oppositely directed fields form current sheets at the interface. Even initially weak hot-phase fields, with $\mathcal{M}_{\rm A,shear}\equiv v_{\rm shear}/v_{\rm A}\sim14$, reduce the mass and enthalpy flux and radiative cooling rate by up to an order of magnitude relative to HD. Magnetic tension weakens turbulent motions, reducing both the diffusion of hot gas into the layer and the folding of the cooling surface. Transverse fields suppress cooling somewhat more strongly than shear-aligned ones, although a transverse field exerts no tension against the initial linear instability. Polarity reversal changes the morphology of the cooling gas without restoring HD-like mixing. The dependence on the Damköhler number is similar to the HD case, but the degree of suppression is dependent on the initial field orientation. The net cooling rate appears resolution-independent in HD but declines with resolution in MHD, and has not converged, so our suppression factors are lower limits. Magnetic fields therefore strongly regulate cooling and mixing in multiphase gas, and quantitative predictions require careful treatment of transport processes.

title: Galaxy And Mass Assembly (GAMA): The Most Isolated GAMA Galaxies
background_knowledge: 在宇宙的大尺度结构中，绝大多数星系并非随机分布，而是处于星系团、星系群或纤维状结构中。星系所处的环境对其演化轨迹有着深刻影响。通常认为，密集的星系环境会通过星系间的相互作用（如并合、潮汐剥离）或与星系团内介质的相互作用（如冲压气体剥离）来抑制甚至‘淬灭’星系的恒星形成活动，使其从富含气体的蓝色盘状星系演化为缺乏气体的红色球状星系。相反，少数缺乏近邻的‘孤立星系’，因免受环境效应的干扰，成为了研究星系仅靠内部物理过程（如长期吸积、内部结构演化、恒星反馈等）进行演化的天然实验室。通过对比孤立星系与群居星系的物理性质，天文学家可以有效区分星系演化究竟是由内部因素（Nature）还是外部环境（Nurture）主导的。
contribution: 本研究利用GAMA巡天数据和客观的孤立度量标准，系统考察了宇宙中最孤立星系的物理特征。研究发现，孤立星系优先呈现出蓝色、盘状和活跃的恒星形成特征，但其属性与群居星系（包括红色的宁静星系）仍有广泛重叠。在控制星系质量的前提下对比恒星形成星系，发现孤立星系与群居星系在恒星形成和恒星种族特征上并无显著差异。该结果表明，由于孤立星系缺乏显著的外部相互作用，当今宇宙中恒星形成星系的演化（至少在富星系团外的所有环境中）一直是由星系内部过程所主导的。
summary: While galaxies generally live in clusters and groups, particularly small groups, or other structures such as walls or filaments, some galaxies appear relatively `isolated', i.e. lacking in close neighbours. Here we use the GAMA survey, and an objective measure of isolation, to explore the most isolated galaxies. We then determine whether these have particular physical characteristics. We find that, as expected, while grouped galaxies split between blue, disk-like and star forming and red, spheroidal and quiescent, isolated galaxies are preferentially the former. However, there is a broad overlap in properties, with some isolated galaxies sharing the latter characteristics. Considering only the star-forming galaxies, when controlled by mass we find no differences between the grouped and isolated galaxies in terms of their star formation and stellar populations. Given the lack of significant interactions for the isolated sample, this implies that the evolution of present-day star-forming galaxies in all environments (at least outside rich clusters) has been, and remains, dominated by internal processes.

title: Metal-Poor Stars as Metal-Rich Impostors via Planet Engulfment
background_knowledge: 在恒星与其行星系统的共同演化过程中，行星可能会因轨道衰减或多体动力学相互作用被母星吞噬（Planet Engulfment）。行星物质通常富含重元素（天文学中统称为‘金属’），一旦进入恒星内部，这些物质会被混合到恒星表面的对流包层中，从而改变恒星表面的化学丰度观测值，使原本的贫金属星伪装成‘富金属星’。同时，行星的轨道角动量也会转移给恒星，引发恒星自转加速（Spin-up）。然而，恒星的对流包层厚度（随恒星质量和演化阶段变化）、主序寿命（MS lifetime）以及恒星内部的旋转混合（Rotational mixing）效应，会共同决定外来金属物质在恒星表面的稀释程度和存留时间。理解这一机制对于通过恒星化学丰度追溯星系化学演化（银河系考古）以及识别系外行星系统的动力学历史具有重要意义。
contribution: 本文利用MESA恒星演化代码模拟了行星吞噬对恒星金属丰度和自转速度的长期影响。研究表明：主序晚期的吞噬事件比零龄主序（ZAMS）阶段能产生更高的表面金属增丰；旋转混合效应总体上会抑制增丰，但贫金属星仍能将超太阳金属丰度维持数十亿年。研究还发现，行星吞噬注入角动量引起的恒星自转加速是瞬态的，恒星会迅速恢复至标准的自转演化路径，因此自转加速不能作为长期的观测指标。由于恒星对流包层厚度和主序寿命共同决定了增丰信号的强度与持续时间（0.7太阳质量恒星信号寿命长但被严重稀释，1.2太阳质量恒星信号强但寿命短），研究得出结论：1.0太阳质量恒星兼具显著的增丰效应与较长的主序寿命，是搜寻行星吞噬观测印迹的最优目标。
summary: Planet engulfment leads to planetary mass accretion and angular momentum deposition into the stellar envelope. This study uses MESA models to investigate the long-term impact of engulfment on stellar metallicity and rotational velocity, as well as the effect of rotational mixing on metal enrichment. Our models show that engulfment occurring during the late main-sequence (MS) stage yields significantly higher surface enrichment than at the ZAMS. Rotational mixing generally suppresses enrichment; however, metal-poor stars can sustain super-solar abundances for several Gyr, whereas high-metallicity stars remain largely unaffected. Although engulfment causes an instantaneous spin-up, this angular momentum injection is transient, and the star quickly re-converges to its standard rotational evolution. Thus, MS spin-up cannot serve as a long-term observational indicator. Because convective envelope thickness and MS lifetime dictate the magnitude and duration of enrichment, identifying engulfment signatures requires balancing the long-lived but diluted signals in 0.7 M_sun stars against the strong yet short-lived enrichment in 1.2 M_sun stars. Consequently, 1.0 M_sun stars offering both substantial enrichment and a relatively long MS lifetime represent optimal targets for observational searches.

title: Stellar Collisions from Self-consistent Stellar Dynamics Around Growing Supermassive black Holes
background_knowledge: 星系中心通常存在着极端致密的核星团（Nuclear Star Cluster, NSC），其核心往往潜伏着一个超大质量黑洞（MBH）。在黑洞的强大引力场作用下，周围的恒星会被加速到极高的速度。在这样高密度的动力学环境中，恒星之间极易发生直接的物理碰撞。这类碰撞不仅可以引发引力波、千新星或类超新星爆发等高能天体物理瞬变现象，还会释放出大量气体供黑洞吸积，并显著改变星团自身的恒星密度空间分布（如密度尖点的演化）。研究核星团的长期动力学演化与黑洞质量增长之间的复杂耦合关系，是理解星系核区极端物理过程与暂现源形成机制的关键前置问题。
contribution: 本文利用GNC蒙特卡洛代码，自洽地模拟了不同质量和密度剖面的核星团中恒星动力学与伴随的气体吸积及黑洞生长过程。研究发现，恒星碰撞会在约0.1至10亿年内使极内区（$r \lesssim 10^{-3}-10^{-2}$ pc）的密度尖点变平缓。随着黑洞质量的增长，恒星速度增加，促使碰撞转变为相对速度超过2500 km/s的破坏性碰撞。这种恒星碰撞与黑洞生长的协同效应在高质量核星团（约$10^9 M_\odot$）中尤为重要，其现今的破坏性碰撞率保持在$10^{-4}\sim 10^{-3}\text{ yr}^{-1}$的高水平，而在类银河系或更小的核星团中则较低或可忽略。这一结果指出了大质量星系是寻找和观测此类破坏性恒星碰撞暂现源的最佳目标。
summary: The centers of galaxies harbor the densest stellar environments, where a massive black hole (MBH) accelerates stars to such high velocities that direct collisions can result in high-energetic phenomena, such as gravitational wave sources, kilonovae, and supernova-like transients. These collisions can reshape the cluster's density profile and release gas that can be subsequently accreted by the MBH. However, the evolving rates of such phenomena from self-consistent dynamics around mass-growing MBHs remain largely unexplored. In this work, we simulate nuclear star clusters (NSCs) across a range of masses and density profiles by employing the GNC Monte Carlo code, that self-consistently models stellar dynamics and the subsequent accretion of released gas. We find that stellar collisions flatten the density cusp in the innermost regions ($r \lesssim 10^{-3}-10^{-2}$ pc) within $\sim 0.1-1$ Gyr. While high initial collision rates in steep cusps quickly decline due to stellar depletion, the interplay between collisions and MBH growth is important only in massive NSCs ($M_\star \sim 10^9 M_\odot$). As MBH grows, increased stellar velocities shift the balance toward destructive collisions of which relative velocities can be $\gtrsim 2500 {\rm \,km\,s^{-1}}$. Consequently, present-day destructive collision rates in massive clusters remain high ($10^{-4}\sim 10^{-3}{\rm yr}^{-1}$), whereas they are smaller in Milky Way-like NSCs or negligible in smaller NSCs. Our results highlight a crucial synergy between stellar dynamics and MBH growth, identifying massive galaxies as prime targets for observing transients from destructive stellar collisions.

title: High-z galaxies with the JWST and the ELT: Toward Ever-finer Detail
background_knowledge: 高红移星系（High-z galaxies）的研究是理解宇宙早期演化、再电离过程以及星系形成机制的核心。由于宇宙膨胀，早期星系发出的紫外和光学辐射被红移至红外波段。探测这些遥远天体需要极高的红外灵敏度和角分辨率。詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的升空彻底改变了这一领域，使人类能够直接观测到宇宙诞生最初几亿年的星系。然而，要进一步解析早期星系内部的精细结构（如恒星形成团块、星团尺度），现有的空间望远镜分辨率仍面临挑战，这需要依赖未来配备极端自适应光学（AO）系统的地基极大望远镜（如39米的ELT）以及自然界的‘宇宙望远镜’——引力透镜效应来实现更小物理尺度的探测。
contribution: 本文总结了JWST在探索早期宇宙方面的初步成就（如发现大质量蓝/红星系和呈现为‘小红点’的活动星系核），并重点展望了2030至2040年代极大望远镜（ELT）的科学潜力。研究指出，配备极端自适应光学系统的39米ELT将能在近红外波段达到衍射极限，其点源扩散函数（PSF）比JWST小约6倍（FWHM约8-12毫角秒）。这将使天文学家能够在任意红移（z < 18）下解析小于100秒差距（pc）的空间尺度；若结合引力透镜效应（即中等放大倍数4-8倍），甚至能探测到小于25 pc的物理尺度，从而使在宇宙学距离上开展星团级别的恒星形成系统性研究成为常规观测。
summary: The exploration of the early Universe is being transformed by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), which delivers unprecedented angular resolution at infrared wavelengths and opens a unique window redward of the K band (2um). Thanks to NIRCam, NIRISS, NIRSpec, and MIRI instruments, which provide both imaging and spectroscopy with exquisite efficiency, new classes of sources have emerged within the first years of operations. The first half-Gyr of cosmic time is now routinely probed, revealing massive blue/red galaxies and a population of Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) appearing as "little red dots" together with a rest-frame near-infrared/optical view of sources across the reionization and post-reionization epochs. Angular resolution will remain pivotal in the 2030s - 2040s, when extreme adaptive optics (AO) facilities will be deployed on both (8 - 10)m (e.g., the VLT Multi-Conjugate-Adaptive-Optics (MCAO) - Assisted Visible Imager and Spectrograph, MAVIS) and on extremely large telescopes, like the 39m ELT (e.g., Multi-conjugate adaptive Optics Relay For ELT Observation, MORFEO). Operating at the diffraction limit, these facilities will improve JWST's resolution, with ELT achieving a factor of ~ 6 smaller Point-Spread-Function (PSF). An ELT diffraction-limited PSF (with a Full Width Half Maximum, FWHM ~ 8-12 mas) in the near infrared will resolve spatial scales <100 pc at any redshift (z ~< 18), revealing abundant star-forming clumps with sufficient sensitivity. Leveraging gravitational lensing as a cosmic telescope, even with moderate magnification factors (mu ~ 4-8), diffraction-limited 8m and 39m telescopes will probe physical scales ~< 25 pc, enabling systematic studies of star formation down to star-cluster scale at cosmological distances. Such observations are poised to become routine in the 2030s - 2040s.

title: Simulating the thermodynamics of gas, radiation, and multispecies dust: Method and applications to protoplanetary disks
background_knowledge: 原行星盘（Protoplanetary disks）是环绕在新生恒星周围由致密气体和多组分尘埃构成的吸积盘，也是行星系统诞生的摇篮。盘内的热力学演化由气体、尘埃和辐射之间的复杂相互作用所主导，深刻影响着盘在宏观与微观尺度上的形态与动力学过程。过去的水动力学模拟受限于计算资源，往往采用近似的热力学设定，如局部等温假设、参数化的β冷却模型，或单纯假设气体与尘埃处于热平衡状态的辐射流体模型。然而，现代观测在光谱、角分辨率和垂直结构探测上都达到了前所未有的精度，揭示了丰富的盘内特征。为了准确重现这些观测现象，理论研究亟需向更加全面、自洽且包含多组分尘气相互作用的辐射流体动力学模型演进。
contribution: 本文针对PLUTO代码开发了一套全新的辐射流体动力学数值方案，实现了气体、辐射以及多种尘埃成分之间能量交换（涵盖吸收、发射和碰撞过程）的自洽计算。该方案通过将每种尘埃成分近似为无压扩散流体来处理尘气动力学，从而能够准确模拟由尘埃颗粒沉降和捕获所引起的盘内光照及热力学条件的变化。作者通过一系列标准测试问题验证了该方案的有效性，并探讨了其在解决原行星盘研究中开放性问题的重要应用潜力。
summary: The thermodynamics of protoplanetary disks, governed by a complex interplay between gas, dust, and radiation, exerts a strong influence on their morphology and dynamics at both large and small scales. Historically, hydrodynamical simulations have treated thermodynamics with approximate prescriptions, such as local isothermality, parametrized $β$-cooling, and radiation hydrodynamics with gas-dust thermal equilibrium. However, a more comprehensive and self-consistent approach would more accurately reproduce the wealth of features found in observations, which in modern times have reached unprecedented spectral, angular, and vertical resolution. With this motivation, we have devised a radiation-hydrodynamics scheme for the PLUTO code with energy exchange (via absorption, emission, and collisions) for gas, radiation, and multiple species of dust. Dust-gas dynamics are handled by treating each dust species as a pressureless, diffusive fluid, ensuring that our scheme can represent changes in disk illumination caused by grain settling and trapping. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our scheme in several test problems, and conclude by discussing its relevance to open questions in protoplanetary disk studies.

title: Extracting Asteroid Physical Properties from Vera C. Rubin Observatory Science Validation Survey Data: Rotational Periods, Colors, and Taxonomies
background_knowledge: 太阳系小天体（如小行星）是记录太阳系早期形成与演化历史的“化石”。天文学家通常依赖多波段测光（Multi-band Photometry）来研究其物理性质：通过持续观测获取亮度随时间变化的光变曲线（Light curve），可以推演出小行星的自转周期和形状（由光变振幅反映）；通过测量不同波段间的亮度差异（即天文学中的“颜色”），能够推断其表面矿物成分，进而进行分类（Taxonomy，如碳质、硅酸盐质等）。Vera C. Rubin天文台具备强大的大视场、高频次、多波段巡天能力，将为海量太阳系小天体的特征刻画提供革命性的数据支持。
contribution: 本文基于Vera C. Rubin天文台早期科学验证（SV）巡天的稀疏测光数据，开发并验证了一套提取小行星自转周期、振幅、颜色和分类的分析方法。作者结合高阶傅里叶光变曲线拟合与多波段Lomb-Scargle分析，构建统一光变模型以提取经自转校正的颜色并进行小行星分类。研究不仅确定了可靠测定周期所需的具体观测条件，还证明引入z波段测光数据相较于传统的gri三波段分析，能显著提升对小行星表面物质成分的分类辨别能力。
summary:
The Vera C. Rubin Observatory will enable large-scale characterization of minor bodies through high-cadence, multi-band photometry. Early Science Validation (SV) observations from 2025-2026 provide one of the first extensive datasets for Solar System studies, but typically with sparser and more heterogeneous coverage than the Rubin First Look data, where hundreds of observations were available for well-characterized objects.
  In this work, we build on the methodology developed for the Rubin First Look data to extract asteroid rotation periods, amplitudes, colors, and taxonomic classifications from early Rubin SV data using multi-band (griz) photometry. Rotation periods are determined through a combination of high-order Fourier light-curve fitting and multi-band Lomb-Scargle analysis. A unified light-curve model is then used to derive rotation-corrected colors, which are converted into taxonomic classes using calibrated color indices and spectral slopes.
  We validate the method on objects with sufficient observational coverage and show that preliminary physical properties can be estimated from sparse and irregular datasets, while robust determinations require improved temporal coverage. By simulating sparsely observed data, we identify the observational conditions required for period determinations. The inclusion of z-band photometry extends traditional color-based taxonomy and improves compositional discrimination relative to gri-only analyses.

title: A Practical Primer on Software Citation in Research
background_knowledge: 现代天文学与天体物理学研究高度依赖于计算软件和代码，涵盖从望远镜观测数据的预处理、海量数据集的统计分析，到复杂天体物理过程的数值模拟。然而，在传统的学术评价体系中，软件开发往往未能像常规学术论文那样获得充分的认可与追踪。建立规范且统一的软件引用机制不仅是保障科学研究可重复性（reproducibility）与透明度的关键，更是为研究型软件工程师（RSE）和工具开发者提供合理学术评价和应有学术信用的必要途径。
contribution: 本文提供了一份关于科研软件引用的双向实用指南，旨在降低规范化引用实践的门槛。文章明确提出了在研究中正确引用他人软件的七步工作流程，以及使自研软件更易被他人引用的五步工作流程。此外，指南解答了关于“应引用哪些软件以及引用多少”的常见问题，并以天文学为贯穿全文的示例，倡导在整个学术界建立让软件开发获得应有学术认可的科研文化。
summary: Software underlies virtually all modern research, yet citation practices for software remain inconsistent and often inadequate. This short primer offers practical guidance in two directions: how to properly cite the software you use in your research, and how to make your own software easy for others to cite. We describe a seven-step workflow for citing software and a five-step workflow for making your software citeable, along with the community tools and resources that support each step. We also address common questions about what software, and how much, to cite. The guidance is field-independent; we use astronomy as a running example throughout, and readers in other disciplines can substitute the equivalent tools and conventions of their own community. Our goal is to lower the practical barrier to good software citation practice and to support a research culture in which software receives the scholarly credit it deserves.

title: Simultaneous PSF Matching via Dual Kernel Optimization
background_knowledge: 点扩散函数（PSF）描述了成像系统对点光源（如恒星）的响应。在天文观测中，由于大气湍流（视宁度）、望远镜光学系统或观测条件的差异，不同波段或不同时间拍摄的图像往往具有不同的PSF。为了进行精确的多波段测光、图像相减（如超新星等瞬变源搜寻）或星系形态测量，必须对图像进行PSF匹配。传统的匹配算法通常选取分辨率较差的图像作为参考，寻找一个卷积核将较高分辨率的图像进行平滑退化，从而使两者的PSF一致。然而，当两幅图像的PSF具有不同的复杂形状或方向时，单向的简单卷积往往无法得到理想的匹配结果；而简单地将两个PSF互相卷积又会导致最终的图像分辨率受到不必要的严重退化。
contribution: 本文提出了一种名为双核优化（DKO）的新型同步PSF匹配算法。该算法不再局限于单向退化图像，而是同时求解两个卷积核（分别应用于两幅待匹配图像），在确保双向PSF成功匹配的同时，最小化卷积核的尺寸，从而最大程度地保留图像的原始分辨率并减少退化。针对该数学问题高度简并的特性，研究引入了随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）算法来严格探索参数空间，确保收敛至全局最优解。此外，论文探讨了相关的算法挑战与约束修正，并展示了该方法在真实天文图像中的实际应用，包括处理视场中PSF存在空间变化（Spatially Varying PSF）的复杂情况。
summary: Standard point spread function (PSF) matching algorithms consider one image as the reference and aim to find a convolution kernel such that, when applied to the reference image, the PSFs of the reference and non-reference images are matched. This method works well if one image is a degraded version of the other. However, this is not always the case: if the PSFs of the two images have different orientations or shapes, a simple convolution of one of the images does not lead to a satisfactory match. While this can be trivially solved by convolving the first PSF with the second and vice-versa, this results in unnecessarily large PSFs. In this paper, we present a new algorithm, Dual Kernel Optimization (DKO), that simultaneously solves for two convolution kernels, one for each image, such that the PSFs match and the sizes of the kernels are minimized. This results in a minimally-degraded final set of PSFs. Since this problem is highly degenerate, we use Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) which rigorously explores the parameter space and converges on the globally-optimal solution.We discuss the algorithmic challenges for this problem and the modifications to standard SGLD used to constrain it. Finally, we include a discussion on the application of this methodology to real-world images, including cases where the PSF varies over the field of view.

title: The Optical Expansion Scalar in Cosmological Perturbation Theory
background_knowledge: 在现代宇宙学中，我们获取宇宙信息的主要途径是观测遥远天体发出的光信号。在广义相对论的几何光学近似下，光束在弯曲时空中传播时，其截面积和波的振幅会受引力影响发生变化。萨克斯（Sachs）光学膨胀标量正是描述这种光束截面积局部变化率的基本物理量，它与宇宙学中关键的观测指标（如角直径距离和有效膨胀率）密切相关。宇宙学微扰理论通过在均匀各向同性的背景时空（FLRW度规）上引入微小的度规和物质分布涨落，来精确描述光信号传播时的路径演化。分析这些可观测量的各向异性和角功率谱，是研究大尺度结构、物质本动速度场以及检验广义相对论的重要研究范式。
contribution: 本文引入了一个新的宇宙学可观测量 $\vartheta \equiv \theta/\omega_o$（即Sachs光学膨胀标量 $\theta$ 与观测光子频率 $\omega_o$ 的比值），并在包含标量微扰的平直FLRW宇宙模型中推导了该物理量的线性微扰表达式及其角功率谱。通过将其功率谱与角直径距离 $D_A$ 的涨落功率谱及相对论性N体模拟结果进行对比，研究发现，尽管研究 $\vartheta$ 的涨落相比于 $D_A$ 没有表现出压倒性的直接优势，但 $\vartheta$ 的各向异性对天体的本动速度和相对论性引力势表现出了更强的敏感性。该研究建立的理论框架为未来开展宇宙学观测的一致性检验、探测偏离标准FLRW模型的效应以及限制修改引力理论提供了坚实的理论基础。
summary: Within the geometric optics approximation, the optical expansion scalar describes the local rate of change in the amplitude of a wave or the area of a light bundle propagating through the Universe. As such, it is fundamental for describing almost all the observations we make in cosmology. It was recently pointed out that this quantity can, in principle, be reconstructed from measurements of the angular diameter distance $D_A$ and the effective observed expansion rate $\mathfrak{H}$. Motivated by this possibility, we introduce the observable $\vartheta \equiv θ/ω_o$, where $θ$ is Sachs' optical expansion scalar, and $ω_o$ the observed photon frequency. We then derive the linear perturbative expression and angular power spectrum for $\vartheta$ in a flat FLRW universe with scalar perturbations. Comparing the power spectra with those of the fluctuations in $D_A$ and with power spectra from relativistic N-body simulations reveals no immediate striking advantage of studying the fluctuations of $\vartheta$ to those of $D_A$. However, the anisotropies of $\vartheta$ do exhibit several unique qualities such as an enhanced sensitivity to the peculiar velocity and relativistic potentials. We suggest that our results may hint at $\vartheta$ being useful for developing consistency tests of cosmological observations and possibly probing departures from FLRW cosmology and modified gravity theories. The formalism developed and presented here provides the foundation for future studies into these possibilities.

title: Metal-poor Brown Dwarf Kinematics from JWST NIRSpec Spectroscopy
background_knowledge: 银河系考古学旨在通过天体的运动学特性和化学丰度，追溯银河系的形成与演化历史，例如识别银河系薄盘、厚盘以及由早期星系并合事件留下的晕星流（如Gaia-Enceladus和Thamnos）。贫金属褐矮星是形成于宇宙早期或银河系早期的亚恒星天体，由于质量小、光度极其暗弱，长期以来难以获取其高精度的光谱数据。为了重构其三维空间轨道并进行星族归属，必须测量其视向速度（Radial Velocity）。詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）凭借其在红外波段极高的灵敏度和中高分辨率光谱能力，首次使得针对这些古老暗弱亚恒星的运动学与化学丰度深度精细表征成为可能。
contribution: 本研究利用JWST/NIRSpec G395H光谱，开展了首个针对贫金属褐矮星的视向速度（RV）巡天项目，样本涵盖23颗不同温度和金属丰度的LTY型矮星。研究提出了一种基于约4.5微米CO基频带的前向建模框架，实现了约5 km/s的视向速度系统测量精度。基于该高精度运动学数据，研究不仅成功辨认出银河系薄盘、厚盘和晕族成员，还确认了WISE J155349.98+693355.2极有可能与Gaia-Enceladus并合遗迹相关，2MASS J05325346+8246465可能隶属于Thamnos星流。该工作系统证明了JWST在提供可靠视向速度和化学丰度方面的卓越能力，将银河系考古学成功拓展至亚恒星领域。
summary: Galactic archaeology relies on stellar kinematics and chemical abundances to identify various stellar populations and associations. With JWST, Galactic archaeology of ancient metal-poor brown dwarfs is now possible through high-sensitivity, medium-resolution spectroscopy. We present the first metal-poor brown dwarf radial velocity (RV) survey using JWST/NIRSpec G395H spectra ($λ/Δλ\sim$ 3,000) for a sample of 23 LTY dwarfs across a wide range of temperatures and metallicities. We introduce a forward-modeling framework to measure robust RVs for brown dwarfs by focusing on the CO fundamental band at $\sim$4.5 $μ$m. By comparing to sources with existing high-resolution RV measurements, we demonstrate that G395H RVs can achieve a systematic uncertainty of 5 km s$^{-1}$, sufficient to examine their Galactic space motions. We identify kinematic members of the Milky Way's thin disk, thick disk, and halo populations in this sample. We also confirm WISE J155349.98$+$693355.2 as likely associated with the Gaia-Enceladus merger remnant, and 2MASS J05325346$+$8246465 is likely associated with the Thamnos stream. Our study systematically demonstrates that JWST G395H spectroscopy can provide robust RVs in addition to detailed chemical abundances, necessary for Galactic archaeology studies. Future discoveries and characterization of brown dwarfs associated with Galactic halo substructures and streams will enable a stringent test of stellar/substellar formation and evolutionary models for diverse metallicities.

title: Triggering star formation by free-floating planets
background_knowledge: 星际介质（ISM）是星系中恒星之间的气体和尘埃。恒星形成是天体物理学中的核心过程之一，通常发生在大质量、低温的巨分子云中。当分子云内部的致密区域由于自引力克服了内部热压力及其他支撑力时，会发生引力坍缩（即金斯不稳定性），气体和尘埃向中心聚集，最终点燃核聚变形成原恒星。另一方面，流浪行星（Free-floating planets）是指不围绕任何恒星公转、独立游荡在星际空间的行星质量天体。探索这些游荡天体与星际环境（如原恒星云）的相互作用，以及它们是否能作为引力扰动源改变或触发恒星形成的经典路径，是拓展恒星形成理论的重要前沿。
contribution: 本文探讨了近期在银河系中发现的流浪行星若被困于原恒星氢云中，对气体引力不稳定性过程产生的影响。研究指出，质量足够大的流浪行星通过在云团内的快速吸积实现质量增长，可成为收缩气体云的替代动力学中心，从而触发恒星形成。此外，由于云团中存在残余的速度和密度梯度，这类触发恒星形成的行星最终很可能停留在围绕新生恒星的遥远轨道上。该研究提出，银河系中部分第二代及后续世代的恒星可能是通过此机制形成的。
summary: Recently, a population of free-floating planets has been discovered in the Galaxy. This paper examines the influence of the planets trapped within a protostellar hydrogen clouds on the processes of gravitational instability in the gas. A sufficiently massive planet can become an alternative dynamic center for the contracting cloud. This occurs due to rapid mass growth from accretion onto the planet within the cloud. Owing to residual velocity and density gradients in the cloud, the planet that triggers star formation is likely to end up in a distant orbit around the newborn star. Some second- and subsequent-generation stars in the Galaxy may have formed via this mechanism.

title: AstroGenesis: A Domain-Specific Multi-Agent AI for Astrophysical Research
background_knowledge: 现代天体物理学研究高度依赖于海量文献的梳理、异构多波段/多信使观测数据的处理以及复杂物理模型的构建。随着大型巡天项目和多信使天文观测的快速发展，研究人员常常需要在各种文献数据库、数据档案库和繁杂的数值计算代码之间频繁切换，这极大地增加了研究的复杂度和时间成本。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）和多智能体（Multi-Agent）人工智能技术在自动化科学工作流方面展现出巨大潜力，但通用AI往往缺乏特定领域的物理基础知识体系以及调用专业天文API的能力。因此，开发专用于天体物理学领域、能够无缝融合文献检索、数据获取与物理建模的智能辅助系统，成为提升科研效率和推动知识发现的重要方向。
contribution: 本文提出并开发了一个专为天体物理研究设计的领域特定多智能体人工智能框架——AstroGenesis。该框架采用监督智能体（Supervisor Agent）与规划/重规划架构协调多个专业智能体，在统一环境中集成了文献检索、多波段数据访问分析、理论建模及研究构思功能。系统当前版本聚焦于耀变体（Blazar）研究，其核心理论建模智能体利用预训练的神经网络代理模型，允许用户通过自然语言交互进行高效的宽波段与多信使建模。文献检索基准测试表明，在针对单篇和多篇文献的复杂查询中，Top-5结果命中相关文献的比例分别达到76.6%和79.2%。该框架成功演示了将数据、文献、模型和假设生成整合为可追溯科学分析的工作流，并具备向其他天体物理子领域扩展的能力，为实现高效、互联且可重复的科学探索提供了强大的工具。
summary: Modern astrophysical research requires the integration of rapidly expanding scientific literature, heterogeneous observational data, and increasingly complex physical models. We introduce AstroGenesis (https://astrogenai.com), a domain-specific multi-agent AI framework that integrates literature retrieval, multiwavelength data access and analysis, theoretical modeling, and research ideation within a unified research environment.The current implementation focuses on blazar research, with specialized agents coordinated by a Supervisor Agent and Planner/Replanner architecture. These agents provide capabilities for retrieving and synthesizing literature, accessing and analyzing multiwavelength observations, performing physical modeling, and identifying research directions. A central component is the Theoretical Modeling Agent, which uses pretrained neural-network surrogate models to enable efficient broadband and multimessenger modeling through natural-language interaction. The framework provides natural-language access to science-ready multiwavelength observational data and retrieval-grounded literature through a multi-stage retrieval and ranking pipeline. The literature-retrieval system was evaluated using two benchmarks: a single-paper benchmark, in which each question targets one publication, and a multi-paper benchmark, in which questions may require evidence from several publications. At least one relevant publication was retrieved among the top five results for 76.6% of the single-paper questions and 79.2% of the multi-paper questions. Representative workflows demonstrate how literature, observational data, physical modeling, and hypothesis generation can be combined within traceable analyses. The framework is extensible to additional astrophysical domains, with the goal of streamlining research workflows and enabling efficient, connected, and reproducible scientific investigations.

title: AGN winds and outflows: from accretion-disc scales to the host galaxy
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）反馈被认为是主导星系演化和调节恒星形成的关键机制之一。超大质量黑洞在吸积周围物质时，能够通过吸积盘内区的辐射压或磁场驱动产生剧烈的物质抛射，这被称为“超高速外流”（UFOs）。这些外流携带着巨大的动能与动量，当它们向外传播并与宿主星系的星际介质发生相互作用时，能够有效加热或吹散气体，从而抑制星系内的恒星形成。高分辨率X射线光谱学是探测黑洞近距高电离态外流（如UFOs）的核心观测手段；而紫外、光学、红外和毫米波等多波段观测则被用于追踪更大尺度上的电离态、中性原子态及分子态气体。当前该领域的核心难题之一，是探明微小尺度（吸积盘）的AGN风如何与宏观尺度（宿主星系）的星系外流在物理机制上实现能量与动量的耦合。
contribution: 本文全面综述了AGN风与外流领域的最新观测进展，重点突出了高分辨率X射线光谱学带来的突破性认知。基于XRISM/Resolve的最新观测，研究首次揭示了最内层的超高速外流（UFOs）具有复杂的运动学结构且在空间上是不均匀的。以典型类星体PDS 456为例，这一发现使得推导出的质量外流率、动量通量和动能较以往有了大幅的上调。此外，文章总结了多波段观测在追踪从微秒差距到星系尺度不同相态外流方面的工作，指出吸积盘风与星系尺度外流的物理耦合仍是AGN反馈中的重大未解之谜，并展望了利用NewAthena、ELT、JWST、ALMA及SKA等下一代多波段尖端观测设施，精确测量外流物理性质及其向宿主星系转移能量和动量机制的广阔前景。
summary: Ultra-fast outflows (UFOs), launched from the inner accretion disc in active galactic nuclei (AGN), are among the prime candidates for driving AGN feedback in their host galaxies. Determining their physical properties and energetics is therefore essential for assessing their impact on galaxy evolution. This review highlights recent observational progress, with particular emphasis on the groundbreaking insights enabled by high-resolution X-ray spectroscopy. The first X-Ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission (XRISM)/Resolve observations of AGN winds have revealed that the innermost UFOs are kinematically structured and inhomogeneous. In the archetypal quasar PDS 456, these observations have led to a substantial upward revision of the inferred mass outflow rate, momentum flux and kinetic power. Complementary UV, optical, IR and mm observations trace the ionised, atomic and molecular phases of AGN-driven outflows from parsec to galactic scales. However, the physical coupling between the accretion-disc wind and the galactic outflows remains one of the major unresolved questions in AGN feedback. Building on the pioneering XRISM results, NewAthena's X-ray Integral Field Unit (X-IFU) will characterise the physical properties and energetics of accretion-disc winds with unprecedented precision from the local Universe up to cosmic noon, while complementary multi-wavelength observations with facilities such as the Extremely Large Telescope (ELT), James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), and Square Kilometre Array (SKA) will determine whether and how their energy and momentum are transferred to the host galaxy.

title: Impact of Heavy Modes on Primordial Black Hole Formation
background_knowledge: 原初黑洞（PBH）形成于极早期宇宙中原初密度扰动极高密度区域的引力坍缩，其形成概率和最终丰度对原初扰动的统计分布极度敏感。如果扰动偏离完美的高斯分布（即存在原初非高斯性），高密度尾部的概率就会发生显著改变。宇宙暴胀理论认为早期宇宙经历过指数级的加速膨胀，在暴胀期间除了主导膨胀的暴胀场外，还可能存在质量较大的“重场”。这些重粒子可以通过与暴胀场的相互作用在原初扰动中留下独特的非高斯性印记（如由三点相关函数描述的双谱和四点相关函数描述的三谱）。“宇宙学对撞机物理”正是致力于利用这些遗留的非高斯信号来探测极早期宇宙的高能粒子物理。然而，重场效应主要在大尺度上被研究，其对极端高密度尾部及原初黑洞形成的影响尚不明确。
contribution: 本文在准单场暴胀（QSFI，即重场与暴胀场耦合的极简实现）框架下，研究了重场模式对原初黑洞形成的影响。研究指出，与多数仅考虑双谱的PBH研究不同，QSFI模型不仅能产生双谱，还能产生显著的三谱。领头阶计算表明，重场非高斯性能有效放大密度分布的高密度尾部，从而大幅提升原初黑洞的产生率。参数扫描显示，当重场质量最小且声速比最大时增强效应最明显，且三谱的贡献可以媲美甚至主导总的非高斯修正。本研究确立了原初黑洞丰度可作为“宇宙学对撞机物理”的全新观测限制途径，揭示了暴胀期重场对原初黑洞形成的深刻塑造作用。
summary: Primordial black holes (PBHs) form from rare fluctuations in the high-density tail of the primordial distribution, making their abundance highly sensitive to primordial non-Gaussianity. Heavy fields during inflation can source such non-Gaussianity, producing characteristic signatures widely explored in cosmological collider physics, yet its impact on PBH formation remains largely unexamined. We investigate this question within quasi-single-field inflation (QSFI), the minimal realization that couples a heavy field to the inflaton. Unlike most PBH studies that consider only the bispectrum, the QSFI can generate a sizable trispectrum alongside the bispectrum, allowing us to investigate their combined effects on PBH formation. In our leading-order calculation, heavy-field non-Gaussianities can amplify the high-density tail and substantially enhance PBH production. Within the parameter scan, the largest enhancement occurs at the smallest heavy-field mass and the largest sound-speed ratio considered. The trispectrum contribution can be comparable to that of the bispectrum and may even dominate the total non-Gaussian correction. Our results establish PBH abundance as a novel observational channel for cosmological collider physics, demonstrating how heavy fields during inflation can significantly shape PBH formation.

title: Limits on Primordial Black Hole Evaporation from LUX-ZEPLIN
background_knowledge: 在暗物质直接探测领域，科学家通常利用极深地下的高灵敏度探测器（如LUX-ZEPLIN，简称LZ，基于液氙技术）来寻找暗物质粒子与靶核碰撞产生的微弱核反冲信号。标准的冷暗物质（由于其非相对论性速度）难以产生较大的动量转移。原初黑洞（Primordial Black Holes, PBHs）是宇宙大爆炸极早期局部密度涨落坍缩形成的假设天体，也是暗物质的潜在候选者。根据霍金辐射理论，质量较小（如10^11至10^13克）的原初黑洞正在经历剧烈的蒸发过程，能够辐射出包含相对论性暗物质粒子的热流（即霍金加速暗物质）。这种高速粒子流如果与地球上的探测器发生相互作用，将呈现出与传统冷暗物质截然不同的运动学和能谱特征。
contribution: 本论文旨在检验质量在10^11至10^13克的原初黑洞蒸发产生的霍金加速暗物质流，是否能够解释LZ实验近期报告的248 keV异常核反冲事件。研究者利用重非相对论有效场论（NREFT）算符和吸热非弹性质量跃迁模型对核散射进行了参数化分析。结果表明，霍金辐射固有的热学分布性质及其相对论运动学特征，必然会导致低能反冲事件的大量产生，这与LZ实验在5.4-50 keV能量区间的严格零结果相矛盾，从而在运动学上排除了该解释。基于这一结论，作者将LZ的低能背景限制转化为了对原初黑洞丰度比例（f_PBH）的全新且极其严格的上限：在90%置信水平下，排除了质量约2×10^11克原初黑洞的f_PBH ≳ 10^-6。
summary: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) collaboration recently reported a singular anomalous nuclear recoil event at $248 \pm 23 \; \rm keV$, accompanied by a strict null result for unexplained excesses in their primary $5.4-50 \; \rm keV$ search window. The macroscopic momentum transfer required to generate this event is kinematically inaccessible to standard halo cold dark matter, naturally motivating models featuring light, relativistic relics. In this work, we investigate whether a contemporary flux of Hawking-boosted dark matter emitted by evaporating Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) in the $10^{11}-10^{13} \; \rm g $ mass range can source the anomaly. By parameterizing the nuclear scattering with heavy non-relativistic effective field theory (NREFT) operators and endothermic inelastic mass transitions, we formulate a strict kinematic exclusion. We demonstrate that the inherent thermal nature of the Hawking emission, coupled with the relativistic kinematics of the incident flux, inevitably overproduces low-energy recoils, aggressively violating the LZ background bounds. Utilizing this failure, we map the LZ low-energy null results into novel, highly stringent upper limits on the PBH abundance fraction, excluding $f_{\rm PBH} \gtrsim 10^{-6}$ for $M_{\rm PBH} \sim 2 \times 10^{11} \; \rm g $ at 90\% confidence level.

title: The geometric origin of the thermal eccentricity law
background_knowledge: 在恒星动力学和天体力学中，开普勒双星系统的‘热偏心率分布’（Thermal eccentricity distribution）是一个经典概念，其概率密度函数通常表示为 f(e) = 2e。该分布传统上是在假设多体系统（如致密星团）通过散射达到统计平衡（即‘热平衡’）的前提下得出的，意味着相空间被均匀占据，且高偏心率轨道比低偏心率轨道更普遍。然而，传统基于统计力学的推导过程往往十分繁琐，掩盖了该分布为何在三维空间中与偏心率 e 呈现简单线性关系的深刻几何与物理本质。探究这一规律的几何起源，有助于更普适地理解双星轨道的动力学特征，并在无需假设热平衡的条件下应用于更为广泛的天体物理场景。
contribution: 本文摒弃了传统的热平衡假设，从纯几何角度揭示了热偏心率定律的起源。作者在 D 维（D≥2）欧几里得空间中考察了相空间分布仅依赖于能量的束缚开普勒轨道，利用刘维尔测度（Liouville measure）推导出了广义偏心率分布公式 f_D(e)=(D-1)e(1-e^2)^{(D-3)/2}。研究不仅指出分布函数与 e 成正比是三维空间（D=3）的独有特征（源于 D-1 个横向动量维度和开普勒周期简并），还进一步证明了两种已知的分布推广形式（即归一化角动量的幂律加权与恒定速度各向异性）实际上是同一个单参数偏心率分布族的两种等价数学表述。
summary: The distribution $f(e)=2e$ is commonly referred to as the `thermal eccentricity distribution' of Keplerian binaries. However, the result does not require thermal equilibrium, and its usual derivations obscure why the distribution is linear in eccentricity. We seek a simple geometrical interpretation of this result and its relation to more general eccentricity distributions. We consider bound Kepler orbits in a Euclidean space of dimension $D\geq2$, with a phase-space distribution depending only on energy, and derive the eccentricity distribution from the Liouville measure. We obtain $f_D(e)=(D-1) e (1-e^2)^{(D-3)/2}$, so that, within this family, $D=3$ is the only case for which the distribution function is linear in $e$. This follows from the $D-1$ transverse momentum dimensions and the Kepler period degeneracy. We further show that two known generalisations -- namely a power-law weighting of the normalised angular momentum and a constant velocity anisotropy -- are, in fact, two representations of the same one-parameter family of eccentricity distributions.

title: Breaking the Blend: A multi-tracer kinematic decomposition method for IFS data applied to disentangling the AGN outflow and circumnuclear ring in NGC 5728 with JWST
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）中心千秒差距尺度的区域往往同时存在强烈的物质外流（AGN反馈）与恒星形成活动（如环核星暴环）。积分视场光谱（IFS）技术能够在获取空间二维图像的同时提供每个空间像素的光谱，是研究星系中心复杂动力学结构的重要工具。然而，由于恒星形成和AGN反馈激发的星际介质发射在空间上经常重叠，且共同影响多数光谱示踪物（发射线），如何解耦这些混合成分以准确解释气体的动力学和能量学特征，一直是观测天体物理学中的一项重大挑战。詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）的高分辨率中红外光谱为穿透尘埃遮挡并精细研究这些核心区域提供了前所未有的数据支持。
contribution: 开发了一种针对IFS数据的多示踪物叠加动力学分解新框架，该方法结合了动力学建模与逐像素通量分解，能够定量剥离不同物理成分的贡献。研究团队将该方法应用于JWST对塞弗特星系NGC 5728的中红外IFS观测数据，分析了12条精细结构发射线，成功将复杂的环核发射区域解耦为‘恒星形成环’和‘AGN驱动的双锥形外流’两个独立的主导结构，并恢复了它们精细的空间形态。该框架具有高度的普适性和可扩展性，为在不同波段及多类目标中实现具有物理动机的光谱成分分离提供了可靠工具。
summary: Integral field spectroscopy (IFS) of the central kiloparsecs of active galactic nuclei (AGN) reveals a mixture of spatially coincident emission from star-formation and AGN feedback exciting the interstellar medium. Disentangling these components remains a challenge, as most spectral tracers are affected by both processes, limiting robust interpretation of kinematics and energetics. We present a new framework for decomposing IFS data into distinct components on a spaxel-by-spaxel basis using a multi-tracer, stacked kinematics approach. This method combines kinematic modelling with imposed flux decomposition per spaxel, quantifying the contribution of each component across the field of view. We apply this method to JWST IFS observations of the Seyfert galaxy NGC 5728 from the Galaxy Activity, Torus, and Outflow Survey (GATOS), analysing twelve mid-infrared fine-structure lines (4.49 < $λ$ < 25.89 $μ$m, 7.9 < IP < 126.2 eV). We find that the circumnuclear emission can be decomposed into two dominant components: a star-forming ring and an AGN-driven biconical outflow. Our method separates these structures and recovers their detailed spatial morphology. This framework provides a general and scalable method for physically motivated component separation in IFS data, applicable across many wavelength ranges and targets, enabling reliable interpretation of complex emission line structures (or morphologies) in active galaxies and beyond.

title: Optical spectropolarimetry of extreme H$α$ line profiles in seven active galactic nuclei
background_knowledge: 活跃星系核（AGN）是星系中心极其明亮的致密区域，其巨大的能量来源于超大质量黑洞对周围物质的吸积。在AGN的标准统一模型中，中心黑洞和吸积盘的外围存在高速运动的高密度气体云团，称为宽线区（Broad Line Region, BLR），其产生的发射线（如氢的巴耳末线系Hα等）通常非常宽阔。然而，部分AGN的宽发射线表现出极其强烈的非对称性（主峰存在高达数千公里每秒的红移或蓝移），这严重挑战了传统的AGN几何与运动学范式。偏振光谱学（Spectropolarimetry）是研究这些致密区域的重要手段，通过测量不同波长光谱成分的偏振度和偏振角，可以有效限制中心由于尺度太小而无法在空间上直接分辨的散射几何结构和物质分布。
contribution: 本文利用甚大望远镜（VLT）对7个已知具有极端巴耳末线轮廓的明亮赛弗特1型星系（Seyfert-1）进行了光学偏振光谱观测研究。通过对Hα谱线轮廓进行详细的光谱分解，研究团队分离了宽线区（BLR）内的运动学子结构，并测量了各组分的偏振参数，从而限制了其内部几何和散射特性。结果表明，宽Hα组分表现出多样的散射几何；其偏振特征随半高全宽（FWHM）的变化揭示了两种独特的行为：即宽线区要么具有大致恒定的标高，要么呈现出在高速运动区域高度降低的分层结构。这一发现为连接赤道与极地区域的盘风（disk-wind）几何模型提供了强有力的观测证据。
summary: Some active galactic nuclei (AGNs) are known to show extremely asymmetric broad Balmer lines, with their main peak redshifted or blueshifted by thousands of km s$^{-1}$, severely challenging our understanding of the standard AGN paradigm. We wanted to explore the causes of such asymmetric features by carrying out a spectropolarimetric study of a sample of bright AGNs with known extreme Balmer line profiles. We present optical spectropolarimetry of seven bright (V $<$ 17.5) Seyfert-1 galaxies obtained with the Very Large Telescope (VLT) FOcal Reducer/low dispersion Spectrograph 2 (FORS2) instrument from March 2012 to January 2013. The main broad Balmer lines (H$α$ and H$β$, and H$γ$ occasionally) were sampled with a resolving power ranging from 350 to 500. We performed a detailed spectral decomposition of each H$α$ profile to isolate kinematic substructures within the broad line region (BLR) and measured the polarization degree and angle of each component, providing constraints on the inner geometry and scattering properties. The broad H$α$ components exhibit various scattering geometries. Their polarization as a function of full width at half maximum (FWHM) reveals two distinct behaviors, corresponding to either a BLR of roughly constant scale height or a stratified structure with decreasing height at higher velocities. This supports a disk-wind geometry linking equatorial and polar regions.

title: Matter density perturbations in Quadratic Gravity
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构的形成源于早期宇宙微小的物质密度涨落。在标准宇宙学模型及广义相对论框架下，这些原初涨落通过引力不稳定性逐渐增长，最终坍缩形成星系和星系团等复杂结构。为了解释宇宙的加速膨胀或解决量子引力重整化问题，物理学家提出了多种修正引力理论。二次引力（Quadratic Gravity）是其中一类重要的理论，它在标准的爱因斯坦-希尔伯特作用量中引入了曲率张量的二次项（如标量曲率平方 $R^2$ 或里奇张量平方）。检验这类高阶引力理论的一个核心标准，就是考查其预言的物质密度涨落演化（即结构增长历史）是否与当前的宇宙学观测相容。
contribution: 本论文研究了完整二次引力理论中的线性物质密度涨落。通过在纵向规范下采用次视界和准静态近似，作者推导出了该理论中有效引力耦合常数的代数表达式及物质密度涨落的演化方程。研究确定了该耦合常数的正实极点，并分析了其对二次耦合参数的依赖性。结果显示，该理论在红外极限下可恢复广义相对论行为，但在大物理波数下有效耦合会受到压制。数值计算表明，极点的存在会破坏晚期演化的连续性，只有无极点区域能支持常规的物质增长。最终结论指出，二次引力通常无法重现标准宇宙学的涨落演化；而在其能够重现的参数空间内，其物理行为与 $f(R)$ 理论高度一致。
summary: We investigate linear matter-density perturbations in full quadratic gravity. Working in the longitudinal gauge and adopting the sub-horizon and quasi-static approximations, we obtain an algebraic expression for the effective gravitational coupling in the theory and the equation for evolution of matter density perturbations. We identify the positive-real poles of this coupling and map their dependence on the quadratic couplings. In the formal infrared continuation, the reduced coupling recovers its general-relativistic value, whereas at large physical wavenumber it is suppressed when both quadratic couplings are nonzero; the single-coupling limits reproduce distinct behaviors. Numerical integrations of the growing mode are performed up to the first pole and show that pole-free regions of the reduced system can support regular matter-growth solutions, while poles obstruct a continuous late-time evolution. Our results show that quadratic gravity cannot generally reproduce the standard cosmological evolution of perturbations and in the regions where it can, it closely matches the behavior of $f(R)$ theories.

title: Recurrent double-peaked $γ$-ray sub-flares in PKS 1424-418
background_knowledge: 耀变体（Blazar）是活动星系核（AGN）的一个极端子类，其核心特征是拥有一条几乎正对观测者视线方向的相对论性喷流。由于强烈的多普勒集束效应，其辐射覆盖从射电到伽马射线的整个电磁波段，并表现出剧烈的宽带光变（耀发）。喷流中的高能伽马射线通常起源于相对论性粒子的逆康普顿散射过程。在耀变体光变曲线中寻找重现性或准周期性的结构，是探究喷流内部动力学和物理几何（如螺旋喷流、激波传播或重准直激波系统）的重要手段。然而，这类天体的内禀光变通常表现为随机的红噪声，因此在统计学上严格区分真实的喷流物理结构信号与红噪声的随机涨落是该领域的关键挑战。
contribution: 本文在耀变体 PKS 1424-418 的两个主要活跃期中，发现了具有重现性的双峰伽马射线子耀发结构的线索。研究测定子耀发内部双峰的特征间隔约为11.8天，相邻子耀发间距约为67天，且红噪声蒙特卡洛测试表明这些结构极难由随机光变单独产生。能谱（SED）拟合与多波段相关性分析指出，多普勒因子的变化在耀发中起关键作用，且该活动可能与致密毫米波核心区相关。研究提出了一种结构化喷流模型，即单个扰动传播穿过一连串准静态的重准直激波，定性解释了观测到的双峰轮廓及特征时间尺度。
summary: We report a hint of recurrent double-peaked $γ$-ray sub-flares in PKS~1424--418 during two similar major active epochs, MJD 56117--56498 and MJD 59669--59978. The candidate double-peaked sub-flares show a characteristic intra-subflare peak separation of $\sim 11.8$ d and a neighbouring-subflare spacing of $\sim 67$ d. Red-noise Monte Carlo tests indicate that the candidate recurrent double-peaked morphology is not easily reproduced by stochastic variability alone, with false-alarm probabilities of $p_{\rm a}=0.0216$ and $p_{\rm b}=0.0006$ for the two active epochs, respectively. In the simulations of the entire \textit{Fermi} Large Area Telescope (LAT) light curve, no red-noise realisation reproduces both epoch-like structures. The spectral energy distribution (SED) modelling shows similar radiative properties for the two peaks of one double-peaked candidate, while changes in the Doppler factor appear to play an important role in the flaring activity. Together with the previously reported near-zero lag between the millimetre and $γ$-ray emission, these results suggest that the recurrent activity may be associated with the compact mm/sub-mm core region. We discuss a possible structured-jet scenario in which a single disturbance propagates through a chain of quasi-stationary recollimation shocks. In this picture, repeated interactions between the disturbance and the shock structure may qualitatively account for both the double-peaked sub-flare profiles and the observed $\sim 11.8$ d and $\sim 67$ d time-scales. Further active epochs are required to determine whether this similarity represents a recurrent long-term behaviour.

title: Image Fidelity is Not Field Fidelity: Joint Thermodynamic Reconstruction and Error Localization in Neural Tomography
background_knowledge: 在天体物理学（如太阳物理）领域，观测设备获取的通常是天体发射辐射的二维投影图像，而科学家真正关心的往往是其内部的三维物理场分布（如电子密度、温度等）。为了从二维投影反推三维结构，通常需要利用层析成像（Tomography）技术解决逆问题。近年来，神经辐射场（NeRF）等机器学习方法被引入科学层析成像中。然而，由于从三维物理场到二维图像的前向映射通常是‘多对一’的，这是一个典型的病态问题：不同的三维物理状态可能会产生相同的二维投影。因此，模型在二维图像上表现出的高保真度，并不一定能保证其重建的三维物理场是准确的。此外，在实际应用中往往缺乏三维物理场的‘真实值’（Ground Truth）作为监督信号，这使得在模型部署阶段评估并定位局部三维物理场误差变得极其困难。
contribution: 本文开发了CoroNeRF框架，通过结合可微的原子发射渲染器，直接从多视角、多谱线的二维辐射强度观测中联合优化并重建三维的电子密度场和温度场。以太阳日冕层析成像作为受控测试平台，论文得出了两项核心结论：(1) 图像保真度不等于物理场保真度。有限通道数据的重建模型即使能完美拟合二维观测图像，其恢复出的三维物理场质量也可能很差；(2) 跨随机种子（cross-seed）的不稳定性可以作为一种在无真实基准（Ground Truth）情况下的有效指标，用于排序和定位局部物理场的误差。不过研究也指出，如果前向模型本身存在偏差，这种基于种子差异的方法仍可能产生错误的共识。该工作深入刻画了神经层析成像在热力学场联合重建中的性能表现，以及基于种子的误差定位方法的实用价值与局限性。
summary: Neural fields for scientific tomography are optimized from 2D images, but the actual quantity of interest is often a latent 3D physical field. Because the forward map is many-to-one, low 2D image error need not certify a correct 3D field. Moreover, the latent field is not directly supervised during training, and its error cannot be evaluated against truth at deployment. We develop CoroNeRF to jointly optimize 3D electron density and temperature fields directly from multiview, multiline intensities through a differentiable atomic-emission renderer. Using solar coronal tomography as a controlled testbed, we evaluate physical-field recovery and test whether cross-seed instability provides a ground-truth-free-at-inference indicator of local physical-field error. We underscore the following two observations. (i) Image fidelity is not field fidelity: spectral ablations show that limited-channel reconstructions can fit their available observations well while recovering substantially worse fields, whereas evaluation on a common richer probe exposes the discrepancy. (ii) Cross-seed instability ranks local physical-field error across tested matched-model conditions, supported by sparsification and physical signal-strength controls. Seed-deviation projections provide complementary directional validation, but shared forward-model mismatch can still produce incorrect cross-seed consensus. These results characterize joint thermodynamic recovery and the usefulness and limits of seed-based error localization in a controlled, single-scene solar tomography testbed.

title: A Stepping Stone Solution to the QCD Axion Isocurvature Problem
background_knowledge: QCD轴子（QCD Axion）不仅是解决粒子物理标准模型中强CP问题的优雅方案，也是极具竞争力的冷暗物质候选粒子。在早期宇宙的高能标暴胀（Inflation）期间，如果Peccei-Quinn (PQ) 对称性已经自发破缺，暴胀的量子涨落会在轴子场中激发出显著的等曲率扰动（Isocurvature Perturbations）。然而，宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）的精确观测对等曲率扰动的幅度给出了极其严格的上限，这与高能标暴胀预言产生了矛盾，被称为‘QCD轴子等曲率问题’。传统的一种解决方案是假设变化的PQ能标——即在暴胀期间PQ能标极大以压低等曲率扰动，在晚期再回落至较小的真实真空。然而，从极高能标向低能标演化的过程极易引发参数共振，并导致PQ对称性的非热力学恢复，从而产生新的理论张力。
contribution: 本文提出了一种‘垫脚石’（stepping stone）机制来解决QCD轴子等曲率问题。作者在理论中引入了一个在暴胀结束前即可达到的‘中间PQ破缺真空’，使得系统后续演化至当今较小的PQ能标时只需跨越中等大小的层级，从而巧妙地缓解了传统大能标演化带来的参数共振和对称性恢复张力。该真空结构通过辐射修正自然生成：结合PQ标量与费米子间的汤川耦合、低能正向四次耦合以及正向六维算符来共同稳定大场极小值和中间真空。论文探讨了由暴胀场滚动触发的两种具体机制（扫描隐藏的非阿贝尔规范耦合或直接扫描汤川耦合），使得在CMB模式退出视界后、暴胀结束前，大场极小值被消除，PQ场被释放至中间真空。研究表明，该模型对暴胀扇区的背反应次要且真空隧穿受到有效抑制，相较于传统的变PQ能标模型，其对高维耦合参数层级差异的依赖大幅降低。
summary: We propose a ''stepping stone'' realization of the varying Peccei Quinn (PQ) scale solution to the QCD axion isocurvature problem. In conventional implementations, suppressing isocurvature during high scale inflation requires a large inflationary PQ scale, while the subsequent evolution toward the much smaller late time vacuum can induce parametric resonance and nonthermal restoration of the PQ symmetry. We ameliorate this tension by introducing an intermediate PQ-breaking vacuum that is reached before the end of inflation, so that the later evolution to the present day PQ scale spans only a moderate hierarchy. The vacuum structure arises radiatively: a Yukawa coupling between the PQ scalar and PQ-charged fermions drives the quartic coupling negative at high scales while keeping it positive at lower scales. A positive dimension six operator then stabilizes a large field minimum, while the positive low energy quartic together with the quadratic terms generates the intermediate vacuum. We study two mechanisms in which the rolling inflaton removes the large field minimum, either by scanning a hidden non-Abelian gauge coupling or by directly scanning the Yukawa coupling. In both cases the PQ field is released toward the intermediate vacuum during inflation, after CMB modes have exited the horizon. We exhibit benchmark regions with subdominant backreaction on the inflationary sector and suppressed vacuum tunneling, and show that the construction permits substantially less hierarchical quartic and higher-dimensional couplings than conventional realizations that depend on a varying PQ scale. The underlying logic may have analogues for extra-dimensional or string axions, where the effective axion decay constant is controlled by geometric moduli, although realizing the required intermediate vacuum in a controlled modulus potential is nontrivial.

title: Mapping the Milky Way in Six Dimensions: A contiguous, homogenised, phase-space catalogue of \textit{Gaia} DR3 tracers up to 250 kpc
background_knowledge: 银河系考古学与动力学研究的核心在于精确获取恒星的三维位置与三维速度（即6D相空间信息）。这对于揭示银河系的形成演化历史、测量质量分布以及刻画暗物质晕结构至关重要。尽管Gaia卫星提供了前所未有的高精度天体测量数据（位置、自行和视差），但对于距离较远（如银晕外侧）的暗弱恒星，其几何视差的精度会急剧下降，且往往缺乏视向速度数据。因此，当前星系天文学的典型研究范式是将Gaia的天体测量数据与各大地面大型光谱巡天（如LAMOST、APOGEE、DESI等）相结合，利用恒星的光谱和测光数据推导“分光光度距离（spectrophotometric distances）”并补充视向速度，从而在更广阔的空间尺度上（延伸至数十甚至数百千秒差距）完整构建银河系的动力学全景图。
contribution: 本文构建了一个包含约3255万颗恒星的完整、均质化的6D相空间星表，覆盖了从银河系内部（>5 kpc）到外部银晕（约250 kpc）的广阔范围。研究团队将Gaia DR3与14个光谱巡天项目（包括DESI、APOGEE、LAMOST等）的数据进行了交叉匹配，通过基于Gaia的零点校正和多巡天数据融合，获得了高精度的分光光度视差和视向速度（远距离距离误差中位数约29%，视向速度误差约8.31%）。该工作提供了迄今为止最大规模、经过良好校准的外晕示踪天体样本（包含超51.7万颗主要为贫金属的远距离银晕恒星），为银河系多组分质量建模、星系考古以及暗物质探测提供了极其理想的独特数据集。
summary: We present a comprehensive, homogenised catalogue of $32{,}552{,}876$ stellar sources with full 6D phase-space information, spanning Galactocentric distances from the inner galaxy ($\gtrsim 5$\,kpc) to the outer halo ($\sim\!250$\,kpc). By cross-matching \textit{Gaia} DR3 astrometry with spectrophotometric distances and line-of-sight velocities from 14 surveys (including \textsc{desi}, \textsc{sdss-boss}, \textsc{apogee}, \textsc{lamost}, \textsc{galah}, and \textsc{ges}), we achieve median fractional distance uncertainties of $\approx2.7\%$ for $d_{\rm helio}\le15$\,kpc, and $\approx29\%$ for $15<d_{\rm helio}\le250$\,kpc. The catalogue-wide median fractional radial velocity uncertainty is $\approx8.31\%$. \textit{Gaia}-anchored zero-point corrections and statistical normalisation suppress both random and systematic errors. Furthermore, we derive spectrophotometric parallaxes from joint photometric and spectroscopic data. Overlapping survey data is aggregated to replace unreliable values and supplement absent velocities, improving completeness and internal consistency. This multi-survey synthesis is externally validated against globular clusters, dwarf galaxies, and stellar streams, yielding precise kinematics. Notably, the sample features $517{,}123$ halo stars extending well beyond the \textit{Gaia} parallax limit ($\gtrsim\!10$\,kpc). These predominantly faint ($G > 17$) and metal-poor ($[\mathrm{Fe/H}] < -1$) tracers, including RR~Lyrae, blue horizontal-branch, and K~giant stars, constitute the largest well-calibrated sample of outer-halo tracers to date. This unique dataset is ideal for multi-component mass modelling, galactic archaeology, and dark matter searches across the Milky Way.

title: Infrared Screening of the Cosmological Constant
background_knowledge: 宇宙学常数问题是现代基础物理学和宇宙学中最深刻的理论危机之一。在标准量子场论中，微观尺度的真空零点能会对宇宙学常数产生贡献，但理论预测的真空能密度通常比天文观测到的实际值（即驱动当前宇宙加速膨胀的暗能量密度）大120个数量级。为了解决这一巨大的能量尺度差异，理论物理学家试图结合量子引力与重整化群（Renormalization Group, RG）方法。在重整化群流的框架下，宇宙学常数等物理耦合参数并非固定不变，而是会随着能标（从微观的紫外能标到宇宙学尺度的红外能标）发生‘跑动’（running）。‘红外屏蔽’（Infrared Screening）机制是指在大尺度（红外端）下，引力场的量子涨落效应可能在动力学上压低或抵消来自微观尺度（紫外端）的巨大真空能贡献，从而使宏观上观测到的有效宇宙学常数自然地降低至当前的哈勃尺度量级。
contribution: 本文提出，观测到的宇宙学常数实际上是由当前宇宙的最深红外尺度决定的，而非由贡献真空能的微观尺度决定。研究团队在爱因斯坦-希尔伯特（Einstein-Hilbert）加上$R^2$项的截断引力理论框架下，深入分析了引力场的量子涨落。研究发现，在广阔的参数空间中，理论会自发产生不稳定性，这种不稳定性引发的大振幅量子涨落主导了重整化群流的演化。随着群流向红外端演化并逐渐失去对其初始边界条件的记忆，跑动的宇宙学常数$\Lambda_k$（$k$为跑动能标）被驱动至一个普适的红外标度关系 $\Lambda_k \sim k^2$。最终，在最深的红外尺度，即当前宇宙的哈勃尺度（$k \sim H_0$）下，宇宙学常数被成功‘屏蔽’至其观测值大小（$\Lambda_{\rm IR} \sim H_0^2$）。
summary: The observed cosmological constant is set by the deepest infrared scale of the present universe rather than by the microscopic scales that contribute to the vacuum energy. We show that this emerges as the quantum fluctuations of the gravitational field are progressively taken into account. Considering the Einstein-Hilbert+$R^2$ truncation of gravity, we find that in a wide region of the parameter space the theory develops instabilities that give rise to large amplitude quantum fluctuations which govern the renormalization group flow. Once the flow enters this region, it remains there all the way towards the infrared and progressively loses memory of its boundary conditions. The running cosmological constant $Λ_k$ ($k$ is the running scale) is driven towards the universal infrared scaling $Λ_k\sim λ_{_{\rm IR}}\,k^2$, with $λ_{_{\rm IR}}= \frac{1}{2(π-2)}$. At the deepest infrared scale $k\sim H_0$ (the current Hubble scale), the cosmological constant is then screened to its observed value $Λ_{_{\rm IR}}\sim H_0^2$.

title: Wave-Optics Imprints of Warm Dark Matter Subhalos with Prompt Cusps on Strongly Lensed Gravitational Waves
background_knowledge: 在宇宙学标准模型中，冷暗物质（CDM）理论预测暗物质结构会分层向下形成至极小尺度，并倾向于在晕中心形成陡峭的密度尖峰（Cusps）。而温暗物质（WDM）模型由于粒子的自由流（free-streaming）效应，会抑制小尺度结构的形成，这通常被用来解决CDM面临的“小尺度危机”。近期理论指出，暗物质晕在形成初期可能会产生一种极其陡峭的瞬时密度尖峰（prompt cusps, ρ∝r^{-3/2}），且在WDM宇宙中，这种尖峰可能会主导那些在自由流抑制下幸存的低质量子晕的内部结构。另一方面，当引力波（如LISA频段）受到低质量暗物质子晕的引力透镜作用时，若引力波波长与透镜体的特征尺度相当，几何光学近似失效，必须采用波动光学（Wave-Optics, WO）范式。波动光学效应会导致引力波信号出现依赖于频率的衍射和干涉调制，这为探测极小尺度的暗物质子晕及其内部结构提供了全新的多信使天文学手段。
contribution: 本研究将强透镜波动光学衍射积分框架扩展至温暗物质（WDM）宇宙学模型，旨在探究LISA频段内的引力波透镜信号能否分辨出带有瞬时密度尖峰的小质量暗物质子晕。研究通过半解析模型生成带有密度尖峰的子晕星表，计算了不同WDM粒子质量（6至100 keV）下500个独立样本的频率依赖放大因子。结果发现：可观测信号的调制强度依赖于WDM子晕质量函数与LISA敏感质量范围（10^4至10^7太阳质量）的重叠，且观测手段仅在20至40 keV的WDM质量区间内具有可靠的诊断能力。进一步研究表明，由于衍射积分主要响应菲涅尔半径内的投影包围质量而非中心密度，瞬时密度尖峰对振幅调制的增强作用十分微弱。因此得出结论：若在强透镜大质量双黑洞引力波事件中探测到百分比级别的信号调制，足以证实菲涅尔尺度上暗物质子结构的存在，但无法有效反推其内部的密度轮廓。
summary: Dark matter halos are expected to form with a prompt $ρ\propto r^{-3/2}$ density cusp at their centres, and in warm dark matter (WDM) cosmologies these cusps can dominate the inner structure of the low-mass subhalos that survive free-streaming suppression. We investigate whether that inner structure is visible to gravitational waves lensed in the wave-optics (WO) regime. Extending the strong lensing WO diffraction-integral framework to WDM, we generate subhalo populations with the {\sc sashimi-w} semi-analytic model, assign each subhalo a prompt cusp through a cusp-halo relation, and compute the frequency-dependent amplification factor $F(f)$ across the LISA band over 500 independent realisations for $m_χ\in \{6, 10, 20, 40, 80, 100\}$~keV. The signal is governed by the overlap between the WDM-suppressed subhalo mass function and the $m_{\rm sub} \sim 10^{4}$ to $10^{7}\,M_\odot$ range to which the LISA band is sensitive. Modulations are negligible for $m_χ\lesssim 10$~keV, reach the percent level by 40~keV, and then saturate to a CDM-like plateau, so the observable reliably probes $m_χ$ only over the intermediate range $\sim 20$ to 40~keV. Repeating the 40~keV ensemble on identical subhalo catalogs with the cusp amplitude set to zero, we find that prompt cusps enhance the amplitude modulation only mildly. Where cusps make up a large fraction of the subhalo mass, free-streaming has already depleted the signal-carrying mass range, and where that range is populated, the cusp lies well inside the Fresnel radius, to which the diffraction integral responds through projected enclosed mass rather than central density. A percent-level detection in a strongly lensed massive black-hole binary would therefore establish the presence of substructure on Fresnel scales without diagnosing its inner profile.

title: PSFSim: PhySics First Simulations for the Point Spread Function of the Roman Space Telescope
background_knowledge: 在天文观测中，点扩散函数（Point Spread Function, PSF）描述了光学系统对点光源（如遥远恒星）的响应。由于光束衍射、光学系统的像差以及探测器的物理效应，理想的点光源在焦平面上会被记录为一个具有特定形状和展宽的光斑。精准建模和掌握PSF对于高精度天文学研究（如弱引力透镜的形态测量、拥挤星场的光度测量以及系外行星探测）至关重要。南希·格雷斯·罗曼空间望远镜（Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope）是NASA的新一代旗舰级红外空间望远镜，其核心载荷宽视场仪器（WFI）旨在提供前所未有的巡天效率。为了在发射前充分评估仪器性能并在入轨后顺利完成调试，研究人员需要开发基于底层物理法则（如物理光学光线追踪和半导体探测器物理）的高精度PSF正向模拟工具，以预测并校准复杂的光学与仪器系统误差。
contribution: 本文发布了一款名为PSFSim的新型正向物理模拟工具，专门用于生成罗曼空间望远镜宽视场仪器（WFI）的点扩散函数（PSF）。该工具通过对望远镜光学系统执行精密的光线追踪计算来生成PSF，同时全面涵盖了各种探测器效应，并支持在光学系统和探测器模型中人为注入微扰参数。此外，作者展示了该工具在未来望远镜在轨调试阶段的多种关键应用场景，包括模拟光学鬼影现象、利用衍射星芒（diffraction spikes）测量光学像差，以及研究反射镜偏振效应对成像质量的潜在影响。
summary: We present a new tool for generating simulated point spread functions (PSFs) in the Wide Field Instrument (WFI) of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. The simulation tool is physics forward, and performs a raytrace of the optical system of the instrument to compute the PSF, while also accounting for various detector effects. The tool also has the capability to add perturbations to the optical system and detectors. We explore several applications of the tool that may arise during the commissioning of the telescope, including optical ghosts, measuring the optical aberrations from diffraction spikes, and studying the effect of mirror polarization.

title: Unpolarized Low-Frequency Tail of Causal Chiral Gravitational Waves
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙的高能环境中（如暴胀时期或一阶相变期间），剧烈的动力学过程会产生遍布宇宙的随机引力波背景。如果在这些早期物理过程中存在宇称破缺（即物理规律在空间反演下不对称），所产生的引力波背景就可能具有手征性，表现为左旋极化和右旋极化引力波的能量或振幅不同。这种手征引力波背景是探测超越标准模型的新物理和早期宇宙基础物理的重要窗口。引力波谱的低频尾部通常对应着极大尺度上的物理特征，研究其渐近行为对理解引力波源的宏观性质与因果性限制至关重要。
contribution: 论文证明了对于作用时间有限且在波动方程中呈二次型的任何宇称破缺引力波源，其产生的手征引力波背景的低频尾部普遍是非极化的，且手征性分数随频率呈线性衰减。作者考察了高斯源和显式的三阶谱模板，并指出低频尾部缺乏手征性的物理根源在于：在极大尺度上，左旋和右旋引力波的产生效率几乎同等地低下。
summary: Parity violation in the early Universe may lead to a chiral gravitational wave background. We show that, for finite-time parity-violating sources, the low-frequency tail of the generated chiral gravitational wave background is universally unpolarized, and that the chirality fraction decreases linearly with frequency. Our result generally applies to any parity-violating gravitational-wave source that appears quadratically in the wave equation. We consider both Gaussian sources and explicit trispectrum templates. We attribute the lack of chirality of the low-frequency tail to the fact that, on large scales, gravitational wave generation is almost equally inefficient for both helicities.

title: Potential binary supermassive black holes in Markarian 231 as a scientific case for the spectropolarimeter POLLUX
background_knowledge: 目前普遍认为，几乎所有星系的中心都存在着超大质量黑洞（SMBH）。在星系并合的等级演化图像中，两个星系中心的黑洞会相互靠近，最终形成受引力束缚的超大质量双黑洞系统。由于星系并合在宇宙历史中频繁发生，这类双黑洞系统在活动星系核（AGN）中应当十分普遍。然而，受限于当前观测设备的望远镜衍射极限与空间分辨率，直接在观测上证认它们极具挑战，多数双黑洞候选体仍依赖于间接证据而非明确的探测。偏振光谱学（Spectropolarimetry）对辐射源的非对称几何结构和散射环境高度敏感，是探测和表征AGN中心未分辨区域精细结构（如潜在的双黑洞吸积盘系统）的强有力观测手段。
contribution: 本研究以类星体Markarian 231（Mrk 231）为核心案例，针对其在紫外至光学波段表现出的独特物理性质（如强烈的波长依赖型偏振及2500埃处的异常通量下降），构建了一个基于超大质量双黑洞几何结构的简化解析模型。研究计算了该双黑洞系统的总辐射与偏振辐射，成功重现了Mrk 231的光谱能量分布（SED），验证了“双辐射源”物理模型解释其独特紫外/光学信号的可行性。该工作不仅展示了偏振光谱学在识别AGN双黑洞中的巨大潜力，还为未来高灵敏度紫外偏振光谱仪（如拟搭载于宜居世界天文台HWO的POLLUX仪器）提供了重要的科学依据，凸显了其在揭示AGN内部结构及双黑洞演化方面的关键价值。
summary: It is now widely accepted that a supermassive black hole (SMBH) resides in the core of nearly every galaxy. Within the context of mergers of galaxies, the central SMBHs from each system should form a gravitationally bound binary system. Given the frequency of galaxy mergers throughout cosmic time, the existence of such binary SMBHs is likely to occur within active galactic nuclei. However, identifying them observationally remains highly challenging. The majority of reported candidates rely on indirect evidence rather than unambiguous detection. The quasar Markarian 231 (Mrk 231) stands out because of its distinctive ultraviolet to optical properties, which includes a strong wavelength dependent polarization and an unusual flux decrease at 2500A. In this work, we investigate the potential of spectropolarimetry as a powerful tool for identifying and characterizing SMBH binaries in AGNs. We have developed a simplified analytical model to reproduce the spectral energy distribution of the quasar Mrk 231 assuming a binary SMBH geometry, and we compute both its total and polarized emission. The main aim is to test whether two separate emitting sources could explain the unique UV to optical signatures of Mrk 231. Such investigations highlight the importance of a future high-sensitivity UV spectropolarimetric instrument. For instance, the proposed Pollux spectropolarimeter for the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO) has the potential to significantly contribute to our understanding of AGNs structure and the role of SMBH binaries in quasars.

title: Probing binary supermassive black hole in quasars tough spectropolarimetry
background_knowledge: 在星系演化的等级并合模型中，星系并合是普遍现象。由于几乎所有大质量星系中心都潜伏着超大质量黑洞（SMBH），星系并合不可避免地会导致两个中心黑洞相互靠近，最终在合并星系核心形成受引力束缚的双超大质量黑洞系统（Binary SMBHs）。当这些黑洞吸积周围物质时，会触发活动星系核（AGN）或类星体现象。尽管理论上双黑洞系统在AGN中应相当常见，但受限于观测设备的空间分辨率，直接探测它们极具挑战性，天文学家通常只能依赖间接证据（如光谱特征或光变）。光谱偏振测量（Spectropolarimetry）技术结合了光谱学与偏振学，由于AGN吸积盘发出的辐射在经过周围介质散射后会产生特定的偏振信号，不同波长下的偏振特征能够有效携带未被空间分辨的几何与动力学信息，从而成为探测类星体内部精细结构（如潜在的双黑洞源）的有力工具。
