contribution: 本文探讨了利用光谱偏振测量技术探测和表征AGN中双超大质量黑洞的潜力。研究针对类星体Markarian 231在紫外-光学波段展现出的独特特征（如2500埃附近的异常总通量下降和强烈的波长依赖性偏振），构建了一个简单的解析模型。通过模拟双黑洞场景下的光谱能量分布（SED），计算了总通量和偏振通量，以检验两个独立辐射源是否能重现Mrk 231的独特性质。该工作不仅验证了偏振特征在寻找双黑洞中的应用潜力，也为未来高灵敏度紫外光谱偏振仪（如拟搭载于宜居世界天文台的POLLUX仪器）提供了强有力的科学支撑，展现了其在揭示类星体内部结构和AGN物理机制方面的重要价值。
summary: Nearly all galaxies are believed to host a supermassive black hole at their center. In the context of galaxy mergers, the SMBHs from the progenitor galaxies are expected to form a bound binary system. Given the high frequency of such mergers throughout cosmic time, binary SMBHs should be relatively common in active galactic nuclei (AGNs). Yet, their direct detection remains a major observational challenge, with most candidates inferred only through indirect signatures. The quasar Markarian 231 presents unique ultraviolet-optical properties, including an atypical drop in the total flux around 2500 A and a strong wavelength-dependent polarization. In this work, we explore the potential of spectropolarimetry as a tool to detect and characterize SMBH binaries in AGNs. We construct a simple analytical model in order to reproduce the spectral energy distribution (SED) of Mrk 231 taking into account a binary SMBHs scenario and we compute the resulting total and polarized flux. Our goal is to test if the presence of two distinct sources can reproduce the unique ultraviolet-optical properties observed in Markarian 231. Such investigations support the case for future high-sensitivity UV spectropolarimeters in order to probe the inner structure of quasars. In particular, the next-generation instrument POLLUX, proposed for the Habitable Worlds Observatory, would be particularly suited to provide new insights into AGNs physics and supermassive black hole binaries in quasars.

title: Exoplanet Detection Techniques: Radial Velocity
background_knowledge: 系外行星探测的径向速度法（Radial Velocity, RV），又称多普勒光谱法，是系外行星天文学中最经典且最核心的探测方法之一。其基础物理图像为：行星与恒星在引力作用下围绕它们共同的质量中心旋转，导致宿主恒星在观测者视线方向上产生周期性的微小摆动。这种运动会引起恒星光谱特征吸收线产生多普勒频移（恒星靠近观测者时发生蓝移，远离时发生红移）。通过利用高分辨率光谱仪精确测量这一周期性的速度变化，天文学家可以推断出不可见行星的存在、轨道周期以及行星的最小质量（M sin i）。该方法曾促成人类首次发现围绕类太阳主序星运行的系外行星，当前研究的前沿正致力于提升仪器精度与克服恒星自身活动性带来的噪声，以期在未来发现真正的‘类地行星’（Earth analogs）。
contribution: 本章为视向速度法提供了一份全面且具有极强实用价值的综合指南。文章详细阐述了高精度径向速度的测量原理、技术限制以及突破小信号探测瓶颈的策略；特别探讨了环联星运转行星（circumbinary planets）探测的独特挑战及实现其首次探测的最新进展。作者通过三个公开数据集（分别针对单星、环联星系统及包含凌星行星的单星系统）提供了数据分析与解释的实操案例。此外，文章还全面汇总了全球现役及即将投入使用的光谱仪资源与开源分析工具，并在补充材料中提供了望远镜观测申请书范本及撰写技巧，为进入该领域的早期研究人员提供了从理论基础到实操观测的完整武装。
summary: The radial velocity (RV) technique enabled the discovery of the first exoplanets orbiting Sun-like stars. Since then, improvements in precision and sensitivity have enabled the detection of smaller planets, bringing us closer to the goal of discovering Earth analogs in the coming years. In this chapter, we provide an overview of the radial velocity method. We begin with a detailed description of the technique, including how precise radial velocities are measured and what limitations must be addressed to achieve reliable detection of small signals. We examine the unique challenges associated with the detection of circumbinary planets and outline the developments that have, for the first time, made their detection feasible using the radial velocity method. With over 2,000 planets detected to date, the radial velocity method remains one of the most reliable techniques, offering valuable insights into the demographics of exoplanets, especially at long orbital distances. As an example of its applications, we provide an analysis and interpretation of three publicly available radial velocity datasets: one from a single star, one for a circumbinary planet system, and another from a single star with transiting planets. Furthermore, we compile information on the spectrographs currently and soon-to-be available worldwide for radial velocity observations and a list of open-source tools designed for their analysis. In the Supplementary Material, we include a sample telescope proposal for obtaining radial velocity data, along with practical tips on writing a competitive proposal to aid early-career researchers entering the field. This chapter serves as a comprehensive guide for understanding the capabilities and applications of the radial velocity method, equipping readers with the knowledge and resources to address their own scientific questions using this technique.

title: JWST Observations of the Metal-poor T Dwarf WISEA J155349.96+693355.2: The First Brown Dwarf Associated with the Gaia-Enceladus Milky Way Substructure
background_knowledge: 褐矮星（Brown Dwarfs）是质量介于大质量行星与极低质量恒星之间的亚恒星天体，因质量不足而无法在核心维持稳定的氢聚变。T型褐矮星属于温度较低的一类，其大气光谱中常存在显著的甲烷、水和氨分子吸收特征。在银河系的形成与演化历史中，曾经历过多次矮星系的吸积与并合事件，其中“盖亚-恩克拉多斯”（Gaia-Enceladus）是银河系早期经历的一次重大并合事件。该事件的遗迹构成了现今银河系恒星晕的重要组成部分，属于这一亚结构的天体通常具有特殊的动力学特征（如高偏心率轨道）和特定的化学丰度（如低金属量、适度的阿尔法元素增丰）。寻找并研究这类古老、贫金属的天体，对于反演银河系的形成历史具有关键意义。詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）凭借其卓越的红外光谱观测能力，使得天文学家能够首次对这些极度暗弱、低温晕族天体的大气成分和物理化学性质进行深度表征。
contribution: 本研究利用JWST的NIRSpec和MIRI仪器对贫金属T型褐矮星WISEA J155349.96+693355.2进行了光谱观测。0.6-12微米的宽谱数据揭示了水、甲烷、氨吸收以及增强的H2碰撞诱导吸收，证实了其贫金属、低温大气的性质。通过大气模型拟合，测定其有效温度约为960 K，金属量[M/H]约为-1.16 dex。基于中分辨率光谱测得其径向速度为-163 km/s，结合自行数据发现其具有极高偏心率（e≥0.9）的银河系轨道。该褐矮星的运动学特征、整体金属量及阿尔法元素丰度均与盖亚-恩克拉多斯（Gaia-Enceladus）亚结构恒星一致，使其成为首颗在动力学和化学证据上被确认与该银河系吸积事件相关的褐矮星。
summary: We present JWST NIRSpec and MIRI observations of the metal-poor T dwarf WISEA J155349.96+693355.2. The combined NIRSpec/prism plus MIRI/LRS spectrum (R ~ 100) provides 0.6-12 $μ$m spectroscopic coverage that reveals the presence of H$_2$O, CH$_4$, and NH$_3$ absorption features, enhanced collision-induced H$_2$ absorption, and weak or absent CO and CO$_2$ absorption, all indicators of a metal-poor low-temperature atmosphere. Comparison of the spectral data to a suite of atmosphere models yields an effective temperature $T_{\rm eff}$ = 960$^{+28}_{-32}$ K and a solar-scaled metallicity of [M/H] = -1.16$^{+0.28}_{-0.25}$ dex. We find indications that the uncertain trigonometric parallax, likely subject to Lutz-Kelker bias, may be overestimated. Adopting the photometric distance yields a bolometric luminosity log$_{10}L_{bol}/L_{\odot}$ = -5.29 $\pm$ 0.10, from which we infer $T_{\rm eff}$ = 974 $\pm$ 56 K, consistent with the temperature derived via our atmospheric model fits. From the moderate-resolution (R ~ 3,000) NIRSpec/G395H spectrum, we measure a radial velocity of -163 $\pm$ 5 km/s, which combined with the source's measured proper motion and estimated distance indicates a highly eccentric (e $\geq$ 0.9) Galactic orbit consistent with an accreted halo object. The UVW kinematics of WISEA J155349.96+693355.2, its bulk metallicity, and its modest alpha enrichment ([$α$/Fe] = +0.15$^{+0.04}_{-0.06}$ dex) are all equivalent to stars identified in the Gaia-Enceladus Milky Way substructure, making it the first brown dwarf with kinematic and chemical evidence of association.

title: A Census of Stellar-mass Black Holes in the Milky Way with POPKIN. I. Isolated Black Holes
background_knowledge: 恒星级黑洞是大质量恒星演化到生命末期发生超新星爆发或直接坍缩的遗迹。尽管近年来引力波观测在河外星系中发现了大量双星系统中的恒星级黑洞，但在银河系内目前已知数量仅约数十个，且几乎全部处于X射线双星系统中。理论预言，银河系中应存在数以千万计的‘孤立黑洞’（Isolated Black Holes），由于缺乏伴星提供吸积物质且自身不发光，它们极难被直接观测。探究这些孤立黑洞的丰度、质量分布和运动学特征（如超新星爆发时获得的反冲速度），对于理解大质量恒星演化、双星相互作用及银河系动力学历史至关重要。目前寻找这些隐匿天体的潜在手段主要包括：观测其吸积星际介质释放的微弱X射线，以及利用引力微透镜效应（Microlensing）捕捉其掠过视线方向时导致的背景恒星光度放大事件。
contribution: 本文开发了名为POPKIN的Python框架，将单星与双星演化模型同银河系轨道动力学相结合，系统模拟了银河系内孤立黑洞（IBH）星族。研究表明，IBH的总丰度主要受超新星（SN）物理机制的控制：基准模型预测银河系内约有4000万个IBH（太阳系1 kpc范围内约8万个），其他SN处方预测数量可达1至2亿个。基准模型给出了明显的双峰质量分布（峰值分别约9和20倍太阳质量，13-17倍太阳质量区间存在低谷），这与某些能产生2-5倍太阳质量间隙黑洞的模型显著不同。在运动学上，未受反冲的IBH多在银道面上保持近圆轨道运动，而受反冲的系统则经历较强的径向迁移。此外，模型估算存在约5000个X射线光度可观的吸积IBH，并预测Roman空间望远镜核球巡天项目有望在5年内观测到约360次由IBH引起的本征微透镜事件。该研究指出，长时标微透镜事件将对决定恒星级黑洞形成的超新星物理模型提供强有力的观测约束。
summary: Gravitational-wave observations have revealed hundreds of stellar-mass black holes, yet only about two dozen are known in the Milky Way, almost all in binaries. We present POPKIN, a Python framework that couples single- and binary-star evolution with Galactic orbital dynamics to trace black-hole progenitors from the zero-age main sequence to the present-day isolated black-hole (IBH) population. Across ten models varying the supernova (SN) prescription, mass-transfer efficiency, and common-envelope ejection efficiency, the total IBH abundance is controlled primarily by the SN prescription. Our fiducial model, with a recently proposed metallicity- and stripping-history-dependent SN prescription, predicts $\sim4\times10^7$ IBHs in the Galaxy, including $\sim8\times10^4$ within $1\,\rm{kpc}$ of the Sun; alternative SN prescriptions predict $\sim(1-2)\times10^8$ IBHs. The fiducial model yields a bimodal mass distribution, peaking near $9\,M_{\odot}$ and $20\,M_{\odot}$, with a deficit at $13-17\,M_{\odot}$. This distinguishes it from alternative prescriptions, some of which populate the $2-5\,M_{\odot}$ mass-gap region. Non-kicked IBHs follow nearly circular orbits near the Galactic plane, with typical peculiar velocities of $20-30\,\rm{km\,s^{-1}}$, whereas kicked systems undergo stronger radial migration and span a broader velocity range. We estimate $\sim5\times10^3$ accreting IBHs with $F_{\rm X}>10^{-14}\,\rm{erg\,s^{-1}\,cm^{-2}}$, nearly all non-kicked; this estimate is sensitive to the adopted radiative-efficiency and hot-flow treatments. For a Roman-like bulge survey, our fiducial model predicts $\sim360$ intrinsic IBH microlensing events over five years in a $1.70\,\rm{deg^2}$ effective area, before survey-selection effects. We propose that long-timescale microlensing events from IBHs can strongly constrain the SN physics governing stellar-mass black hole formation.

title: Testing cosmic acceleration from thermogravity without vacuum energy
background_knowledge: 目前宇宙学标准模型（ΛCDM）引入了真空能（宇宙学常数Λ）来解释宇宙晚期的加速膨胀现象，但这一假设面临着严重的理论挑战，如宇宙学常数问题。为了解决这些问题，物理学家提出了多种替代理论，例如无迹爱因斯坦方程或热引力（Thermogravity）理论。在这类修改引力或替代理论中，真空能可能不直接参与引力相互作用，而是允许能量守恒定律发生受控的破缺（如物质创生过程）。这种能量不守恒效应有望在不引入额外真空能的情况下，自然地驱动宇宙晚期的加速膨胀。各种宇宙学观测（如超新星、重子声学振荡 BAO、微波背景辐射 CMB 等）常被用来检验这些替代模型是否与真实宇宙的演化相符，以及它们是否能缓解当前宇宙学面临的观测危机（如哈勃常数 H_0 危机）。
contribution: 本文首次在背景演化层面对一种热引力理论进行了观测检验。该理论中宇宙学常数不产生引力（设为 Λ=0），晚期加速膨胀完全由能量不守恒驱动。研究对比了两种模型：一是所有成分均不守恒的普遍模型，在结合超新星和DESI BAO数据后被强烈排除（拟合变差 Δχ² ≃ 51），因为物质创生效应将中等红移的哈勃参量与当今的加速膨胀绑定得过于僵化；二是仅冷暗物质（CDM）不守恒的 ξCDM 模型，该模型在背景数据集上比标准 ΛCDM 模型给出了更好的拟合结果（Δχ² = -4.85）。然而作者指出，当使用早期宇宙（BBN或CMB）数据校准 BAO 标尺时，ξCDM 模型中早期有效 CDM 密度的降低会增大声学视界，导致推导出的 H_0 值更低，从而进一步加剧而非缓解了当前的哈勃常数危机。
summary: We present a first background-level observational test of a thermogravity theory in which the Einstein equations are clipped to a trace-free version, the cosmological constant $Λ$ does not gravitate, and controlled violations of energy conservation obstruct the usual reinstatement of $Λ$ as an integration constant. We therefore set $Λ=0$ and ask whether late-time acceleration can instead be generated solely by energy non-conservation, with no extra background parameter relative to flat $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$. We contrast a minimal universal implementation with a model in which only CDM partakes in non-conservation. The universal model is strongly disfavored when combining Supernovae and BAO distances, with the inclusion of DESI BAO worsening the fit by $Δχ^2\simeq 51$ relative to $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$, because matter creation ties the intermediate-redshift normalization of $H(z)$ too rigidly to the present acceleration. This conclusion, however, should be interpreted with caution, since universal non-conservation would modify the observational dictionary itself. By contrast, restricting non-conservation to CDM leaves baryonic and photon observables unaffected at the background level and therefore allows a self-contained analysis. The resulting $ξ\mathrm{CDM}$ model, which can be thought of as a one parameter extension of $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$, provides an improved fit relative to $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$ for the background dataset combinations considered, with improvements reaching $Δχ^2=-4.85$ and a maximum Bayesian preference of $\ln\mathcal{B}=2.77$. However, when the BAO ruler is calibrated using BBN or CMB information, the reduced effective early-time CDM density increases the sound horizon and drives $H_0$ towards lower values, thereby increasing rather than alleviating the tension with the distance-ladder calibration.

title: Mass-Dependent Dark Matter Deficit from Inelastic Scattering
background_knowledge: 在标准冷暗物质（CDM）宇宙学模型中，流体动力学模拟通常预测星系中心的暗物质晕会形成陡峭的密度尖峰（NFW轮廓）。然而，越来越多的天文观测（如恒星动力学和中性氢旋转曲线）发现在许多近邻星系和矮星系的中心，暗物质密度分布较为平缓，甚至存在明显的‘暗物质缺失’现象，这被称为‘核-尖峰问题’（Core-Cusp Problem）。为了解决冷暗物质在小尺度上的这些理论与观测的冲突，物理学家提出了自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）等模型。其中，非弹性暗物质模型假设暗物质具有多重能态（如基态和激发态），通过在散射中释放或吸收能量（放热或吸热过程）来向中心区域注入动能，从而改变暗物质在不同引力势阱（即不同碰撞速度）下的密度分布规律。
contribution: 提出了一种具有强烈速度依赖的放热非弹性暗物质模型，成功解释了近邻星系中心暗物质缺失量随恒星质量系统性增长的观测现象。研究表明，两个近乎简并的暗物质态通过矢量和标量媒介相互作用，在低速时（矮星系尺度）抑制转换但保留弹性散射以形成暗物质核；在几百km/s时（较大质量星系尺度）触发p波增强的向下散射，向星系中心注入动能并降低暗物质密度。该模型完美再现了四个不同恒星质量区间的观测数据，并预测其效应在星系团尺度会减弱，表明流体动力学模拟与观测的差异可能源于此前未知的暗物质微观物理机制。
summary: Recent stellar-kinematic and neutral-hydrogen observations indicate a dark matter deficit within the central tens of kiloparsecs of nearby galaxies that grows systematically with stellar mass relative to hydrodynamical simulations. We show that this mass dependence can arise from exothermic inelastic dark matter with strongly velocity-dependent scattering. Two nearly degenerate dark matter states interact through vector and scalar mediators with opposite-sign contributions and unequal ranges. The resulting coupled-channel dynamics suppresses $s$-wave conversion at low velocity while retaining a $p$-wave enhancement at several hundred $\rm km/s$, where down-scattering injects kinetic energy and lowers central dark matter densities. At dwarf velocities, conversion remains suppressed while elastic scattering can still drive core formation consistent with the observed dwarf-clustering pattern. A late dark-sector phase transition, along with the low-velocity suppression, preserves a large excited-state fraction until halo formation. Using representative halos spanning the four observed stellar-mass bins, we find that the model accounts for the inferred dark matter deficit in all four bins, including its systematic growth with stellar mass, while its impact weakens toward cluster velocities. The growing discrepancy with hydrodynamical simulations may therefore offer a glimpse of previously hidden dark matter microphysics.

title: QCD Crossover Transfer Functions for Scalar-Induced Gravitational Waves in the PTA Band
background_knowledge: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）通过高精度监测银河系内毫秒脉冲星信号的到达时间，致力于探测纳赫兹（nHz）频段的随机引力波背景（SGWB）。近期，多个PTA合作组报告了该频段存在引力波背景的强烈证据。在早期宇宙演化模型中，大振幅的原初曲率扰动在重新进入宇宙视界时，会通过非线性二阶效应诱发产生标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）。这类引力波的频谱特征高度依赖于当时宇宙流体的状态方程。当宇宙温度降至约150 MeV时，会经历量子色动力学（QCD）平滑相变（Crossover），导致宇宙流体的状态方程发生软化。由于纳赫兹频段引力波对应的尺度恰好与QCD相变时期的视界尺度相符，研究该时期的状态方程演化对精确预测诱导引力波背景能谱以及约束原初黑洞（PBH）的形成具有至关重要的作用。
contribution: 本文精确求解了跨越整个标准模型（SM）热历史的张量和标量运动方程，量化了QCD相变时期状态方程软化对纳赫兹频段标量诱导引力波的影响，并制表输出了传递函数供当前和未来PTA分析直接使用。研究发现，相对于纯辐射为主的假设，QCD相变效应会使PTA频段的诱导引力波谱高度发生高达约55%的改变（增大或减小取决于源模式穿越视界的时间）。结合NANOGrav 15年数据拟合表明，纳入该效应会显著偏移推断出的引力波峰值振幅与尺度，其偏移量足以影响目前对原初黑洞过度产生的限制标准。文章强调，随着未来PTA数据灵敏度的提升和统计误差的缩小，忽略这一标准模型物理效应将导致显著的参数推断偏差。
summary: Pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations have reported evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background in the nHz band. Should scalar-induced GWs, sourced at second order by enhanced primordial curvature perturbations, contribute to this signal, a coincidence of scales makes them directly sensitive to the softening of the equation of state around the QCD crossover. We solve the tensor and scalar equations of motion across the Standard Model (SM) thermal history and tabulate the transfer functions for direct use in present and future PTA analyses. We show that this SM effect modifies the height of the induced spectrum by up to $\approx55\%$ across the PTA band relative to the radiation-domination expectation, with either sign depending on whether the source modes cross the horizon before or after the crossover. Fitting the NANOGrav 15-year data with a broken-power-law curvature power spectrum, we find that including the crossover shifts the inferred peak amplitude and scale by an amount that could already be relevant for the comparison with primordial black hole overproduction bounds. The importance of this SM effect will grow as the statistical uncertainty on the amplitude and scale shrinks with future, more sensitive PTA datasets, at which point neglecting it could significantly bias the inference.

title: Uber-calibration-based Two-level Radial-velocity Zero-point Correction for APOGEE
background_knowledge: APOGEE（阿帕奇点天文台星系演化探索计划）是国际重要的高分辨率近红外恒星光谱巡天项目，为海量银河系恒星提供了精确的视向速度（Radial Velocity, RV）和化学丰度信息。视向速度是研究银河系结构与动力学、双星系统分布等课题的核心观测指标。然而，在长达十余年的观测基线中，光谱仪不可避免地会受到微小仪器系统误差的影响，如曝光间的漂移、不同光纤间的固有偏差，以及因设备维护或更换导致的性能跳变等。传统的基于定标灯的波长校准往往无法完全追踪和消除这些零点系统误差，从而限制了视向速度长期测量的极限精度。超级校准（Uber-calibration）是一种利用大样本中的重复观测或重叠数据，通过全局优化自洽地推导并消除多重系统偏差的数据处理框架。
contribution: 本研究提出并应用了一种基于超级校准框架的双层视向速度零点校准方法，利用大量的重复观测数据，直接从APOGEE公开的单次访问（per-visit）视向速度中推断并去除了仪器零点系统误差。作者依次求解了两组校准偏移量：曝光级别的（星板，夜晚）偏移和时间依赖的（光纤，观测年份）偏移。该方法成功应用于DR17和DR19数据集，使同光纤两日内重复测量的极限精度达到约14 m/s，并将长基线单次访问的测量精度提升了一倍（从98.2 m/s优化至44.7 m/s）。团队最终发布了包含约93万颗恒星、逾350万次观测的视向速度增值星表，为恒星视向速度变率、双星及银河系动力学研究提供了更高精度的数据支持。
summary: APOGEE delivers high-resolution, near-infrared spectroscopy and highly precise radial velocities (RVs), with extensive repeat observations spanning more than a decade. Long-term RV repeatability is nevertheless limited by instrumental zero-point systematics: exposure-to-exposure drift and fiber-dependent offsets that are only partially tracked by lamp-based wavelength calibration, and that can evolve as fibers are serviced or replaced. We infer and remove these zero points directly from the published per-visit RVs using an uber-calibration framework based on shared repeat observations. We solve sequentially for two sets of minimal calibration units: (plate, night) exposure-level offsets and time-dependent (fiber, observing year) offsets. We apply the method independently to APO and LCO DR17 and to APO DR19. After correction, the same-fiber repeatability within two days reaches a limiting precision of ~14 m/s, and the long-baseline single-visit precision improves by a factor of two from 98.2 to 44.7 m/s. We release per-visit, value-added RV catalogs for DR17 (APO+LCO) and DR19 (APO) containing 3,501,727 visits (3,336,141 fully corrected) of 930,519 unique stars, enabling more reliable RV variability, binary, and Galactic-dynamics studies.

title: DETECT: Real-Time Identification of Transients with DESI Spectroscopic Redshift
background_knowledge: 现代时域天文学（Time-Domain Astronomy）依托大视场巡天项目，每月会发现数以万计的暂现源（Transients，如超新星、千新星等）。然而，受限于望远镜的观测时间和光谱资源，仅有极少部分（约百分之几）的暂现源能够获得及时的光谱观测以确认其物理本质。为了从海量警报中快速筛选出高科学价值的特殊目标（例如极端明亮的超新星或暗弱快速衰减的千新星），天文学家亟需在发现之初获取暂现源的距离（红移）信息。通过将暂现源位置与已有的大规模星系光谱巡天数据（如暗能量光谱巡天 DESI）进行实时交叉匹配，可以快速确定其宿主星系的光谱红移，进而推断出暂现源的绝对星等和本征光度。这是目前应对海量暂现源警报、实现高效目标‘分诊（triage）’与后续观测调度的核心研究范式。
contribution: 本文开发了DETECT（DESI-暂现源交叉匹配工具）自动化管线，能够在一小时内将暂现源名称服务器（TNS）的警报与DESI的2200万条光谱数据进行实时匹配。该管线利用校准后的方向-光半径规则（完备率92.5%，误报率0.4%）将暂现源与宿主星系可靠关联，利用宿主红移计算绝对星等等物理量，并对后续光谱观测进行优先级排序。对过去约12万份历史数据的测试成功为15%的暂现源找到光谱宿主，并构建了包含约5400个样本的‘黄金样本’；在2025年的实际运行中，该系统在数小时内成功标记出透镜化超亮超新星SN 2025wny及多个千新星候选体，证明了利用存档光谱数据进行暂现源快速筛选的可行性，为即将到来的Rubin LSST时代奠定了基础。
summary: Wide-field surveys now report thousands of transients per month, while spectra are obtained for only a few per cent of them. We present DETECT (DESI--Transient Event Cross-matching Tool), a pipeline that turns each Transient Name Server (TNS) alert into a distance-informed candidate within an hour by placing it in the context of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) archive. DETECT cross-matches every new report against the 22 million spectra of DESI EDR and DR1 through a HEALPix index, associates the transient with a host galaxy by a directional-light-radius rule whose morphology-dependent thresholds are calibrated on 4,474 supernovae with known redshifts (92.5% completeness, 0.4% wrong hosts), and passes ambiguous cases to a reviewer through a web interface. With a validated host redshift it derives the peak absolute magnitude, the projected offset and basic host properties of each event, and ranks it for spectroscopic follow-up. Applied retrospectively to ~1.2x10^5 TNS reports from 2020--2024, DETECT recovers a spectroscopic host for 15% of them, from these we build a Gold Sample of ~5,400 well-sampled light curves whose luminosity distributions by class reproduce those of untargeted surveys. Because the absolute magnitude is known at discovery, intrinsically overluminous events stand out immediately: in the prospective 2025 run this is how the lensed superluminous supernova SN~2025wny was flagged within hours of its report, and how faint, fast-declining kilonova candidates were screened against model grids and archival photometry. DETECT shows how an archival spectroscopic survey can make host redshifts a routine part of transient triage ahead of the Rubin Observatory's LSST.

title: Statistics of large-scale structure from the transition probability of Lagrangian trajectories
background_knowledge: 宇宙大尺度结构的演化通常通过追踪物质微粒在引力作用下的运动轨迹来描述（即拉格朗日微扰理论）。在此框架下，两点相关函数是刻画物质空间成团性的核心统计量。在宇宙演化过程中，大尺度上的非线性引力运动会导致物质分布特征（如重子声波振荡 BAO 尺度）产生抹平或展宽效应。为了在理论模型中准确预测这些效应，传统的微扰理论通常需要引入‘红外重和’（Infrared Resummation）技术，以非微扰的方式修正大尺度物质位移场对相关函数特征的抑制作用。
contribution: 提出了一种描述引力聚类的纯概率学方法。作者完全在位形空间中开展研究，证明了两点相关函数可以通过刻画粒子给定初始位置后其最终位置的‘跃迁概率’来表述。研究发现，该跃迁概率在初始时呈尖峰分布，随后随时间表现出类似扩散的展宽特征；这种效应对大间距粒子（例如处于重子声波尺度上的粒子）尤为显著，会导致两点相关函数被有效抑制，从而在位形空间中直观且自然地再现了通常所谓的‘红外重和’效应。
summary: We describe a probabilistic approach to gravitational clustering. Working purely in configuration space, we show that the two-point function can be formulated in terms of a transition probability describing the likely final position of a particle given its initial position. The transition probability is initially sharply peaked and then over time broadens out in a diffusion-like manner. The effect is more pronounced for widely-separated particles (e.g.\ at the baryon acoustic scale), leading to an effective suppression of the two-point function in what is normally referred to as infrared resummation.

title: CERIDWEN: Fast and Flexible GPU-Accelerated Stellar Population Inference
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化领域，推断星系物理性质的一个核心范式是光谱能量分布（SED）拟合。天文学家通过构建包含恒星族演化、星云发射、星际尘埃衰减与热发射等物理过程的理论正向模型，将其与观测到的多波段测光或光谱数据进行比对，从而利用贝叶斯推断反推星系的恒星质量、恒星形成历史（SFH）以及化学增丰（如金属丰度）等关键参数。然而，随着詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）以及未来的Euclid、LSST和Roman等大规模巡天项目带来海量且高质量的观测数据，传统的基于CPU的SED拟合工具在处理高维度、非参数化等复杂的恒星族模型时，面临极其严重的计算效率瓶颈。
contribution: 本文开发了名为CERIDWEN的GPU加速SED拟合框架。该框架基于JAX编写，提供了一个端到端可微的正向模型，支持在GPU上并行运行嵌套采样，并可利用自动微分技术为基于梯度的采样器提供精确梯度。CERIDWEN支持极高灵活度的物理推断（如包含约120个年龄区间的非参数化恒星形成历史、随时间变化的化学增丰历史，以及[Fe/H]与[α/Fe]的联合推断）。测试表明，该工具不仅能在模拟数据中准确还原参数及后验不确定性，在拟合真实JWST数据时也能得到与主流工具Prospector一致的结果，且在单GPU上的单次拟合中位时间仅约4分钟（比同等CPU版本快约134倍），使在大样本星系上应用复杂贝叶斯恒星族推断成为现实。
summary: JWST has increased both the number of high-redshift galaxies with high-quality spectral energy distributions (SEDs) and their information content. In parallel, wide-area surveys from Euclid, Rubin's LSST, and Roman will increase galaxy samples by orders of magnitude. Analysing these datasets requires stellar-population models that are both flexible and computationally efficient. We present CERIDWEN, a GPU-native SED fitting framework written in JAX, with an end-to-end differentiable forward model spanning stellar populations, nebular emission, dust attenuation and emission, and projection into the observer frame. Its vectorised, compiled architecture lets nested sampling replace a batch of live points in parallel on the GPU, which makes flexible stellar-population models tractable under full Bayesian inference. Automatic differentiation also provides exact gradients for the gradient-based samplers in the package. We jointly infer time-dependent chemical-enrichment histories instead of a single stellar metallicity, and demonstrate non-parametric star-formation histories (SFHs) with $\sim$120 age bins. Using $α$-enhanced stellar libraries from FSPS, CERIDWEN can sample stellar [$α$/Fe] jointly with [Fe/H], mass, and SFH, so that the joint posterior represents the [Fe/H]-[$α$/Fe] degeneracy explicitly. In controlled mocks, CERIDWEN recovers parameters with well-calibrated posterior uncertainties, while fits to real JWST observations reproduce posteriors from the established Prospector framework: on a single GPU, CERIDWEN completes a fit in a median sampling time of $\sim$4 min, $\sim$134$\times$ faster per fit than equivalent CPU-based Prospector runs. CERIDWEN therefore makes full Bayesian inference practical for larger galaxy samples and more flexible stellar-population models, reducing computational constraints on the physical complexity explored in SED fitting.

title: Two-rung ladder: $H_0$ from Tip of the Red Giant Branch and geometric anchors alone
background_knowledge: 宇宙学标准模型面临的一个重大挑战是“哈勃危机”（Hubble Tension），即通过早期宇宙（如宇宙微波背景辐射）推算的哈勃常数（$H_0$）与通过晚期宇宙局部距离阶梯直接测量的$H_0$之间存在显著且难以调和的差异。传统的局部距离阶梯主要依赖造父变星和Ia型超新星（构成“三级阶梯”）。近年来，红巨星分支星（TRGB）作为一种独立、非年轻恒星的“标准烛光”，被广泛用于替代或交叉检验造父变星。TRGB标志着低质量恒星演化至核心氦闪的阶段，其光度函数在特定波段呈现出极其清晰的截断。然而，在利用近邻宇宙（如退行速度 $cz \lesssim 1000$ km/s）的星系直接测量$H_0$时，观测到的星系红移不仅包含宇宙学膨胀，还受到由局部大尺度结构引力势引发的本动速度（Peculiar Velocity）的强烈影响。因此，精确重建并扣除局部密度场与本动速度场是提取纯宇宙学红移、降低$H_0$系统误差的核心关键。
contribution: 本研究抛弃了超新星层级，仅利用红巨星分支星（TRGB）和几何锚点（大麦哲伦云与NGC 4258）构建了“两级距离阶梯”，基于约400个具有TRGB距离的星系直接推断$H_0$。研究团队采用前向建模方法处理了星等限制、曝光时间和星系偏置等选择效应，并结合了80个局部密度场与本动速度场的模拟实现进行条件推断。研究发现，由于绝大多数目标星系位于低红移区域（$cz \lesssim 1000$ km/s），推断的精度受限于本动速度场的方差而非TRGB自身的标定误差。等权重组合所有速度场实现得出 $H_0 = 68.4 \pm 5.9$ km/s/Mpc，而按贝叶斯证据加权则得出 $72.3 \pm 2.6$ km/s/Mpc（后者对单一高证据实现高度敏感）。结论指出，当前的纯TRGB阶梯受限于局部速度场涨落，尚无法有效仲裁哈勃危机；未来需要将TRGB观测拓展至1000 km/s以上的宇宙空间，并进一步改进局部宇宙的场重建工作。
summary: We infer the Hubble constant $H_0$ from the ~400 Extragalactic Distance Database hosts with a tip of the red giant branch (TRGB) distance, calibrated on the geometric anchors of the Large Magellanic Cloud and NGC 4258. We forward-model the tip magnitudes and host redshifts including magnitude-limited selection, sky exposure, and density-dependent galaxy bias, conditioning on each of the 80 Manticore-Local realisations of the local density and peculiar-velocity fields in turn. As most hosts lie at $cz_{\rm CMB} \lesssim 1000$ km/s, where peculiar velocities are important, the inference is limited by the variance of these fields rather than by the TRGB calibration. For a fixed realisation, the redshift likelihood and density smoothing each move $H_0$ by less than 1 km/s/Mpc and a velocity monopole by $5.4 \pm 3.4$ km/s/Mpc, whereas the field-to-field scatter in $H_0$ is 5.2 km/s/Mpc. Weighting the posteriors from each realisation equally gives $H_0 = 68.4 \pm 5.9$ km/s/Mpc, while weighting each by its Bayesian evidence gives $72.3 \pm 2.6$ km/s/Mpc. The latter value is set by a single particularly high-evidence realisation, making it sensitive to the finite sampling of the reconstruction posterior. This ladder therefore cannot yet arbitrate the Hubble tension. Extending the TRGB data beyond the present ~1000 km/s, together with improved reconstructions of the local Universe, would reduce the field-to-field scatter well below the 5.2 km/s/Mpc we find here.

title: Dissecting the variability of Sagittarius A* in the orbiting hotspot framework
background_knowledge: 银河系中心的超大质量黑洞人马座A*（Sgr A*）通常处于辐射相对微弱的宁静状态，但会表现出间歇性的耀发（flaring）现象，主要特征为红外和X射线等高能波段的辐射出现短暂且强烈的增强。为了解释这种多波段的快速光变，天体物理学中常采用“轨道热点”（orbiting hotspot）模型，认为这些耀发源于黑洞附近局域化的高能等离子体团（即“热点”）在强引力场中的相干轨道运动。这一理论框架结合了广义相对论效应和等离子体辐射机制，是限制黑洞及其周边极端物理环境（如吸积流结构、自旋和磁场等）的重要工具。
contribution: 本文是一篇简明的综述论文，系统探讨了基于“轨道热点”模型解析人马座A*（Sgr A*）光变特性的最新观测与理论进展。论文不仅肯定了该理论框架在限制Sgr A*物理性质方面取得的丰硕成果，还重点讨论了该模型当前所面临的重大挑战与局限性，并对热点模型的有效性争议以及未来研究的发展前景进行了深入评述。
summary: Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*) exhibits intermittent flaring behavior, characterized by strong enhancements in high-energy emission (infrared and X-ray). These events have been interpreted as related to the coherent orbital motion of localized regions of energized plasma - hotspots. While this framework has been quite fruitful in constraining properties of Sgr A*, it is subject to important challenges and limitations. In this brief review we discuss the recent observational and theoretical developments related to this line of research, commenting on the concerns regarding the hotspot model validity and the future perspectives.

title: Cluster Membership Probabilities: A Review of Methods and Gaia Applications
background_knowledge: 恒星团（如疏散星团和球状星团）是由同一巨分子云在相近时间内坍缩形成的恒星系统，其成员星通常具有相似的年龄、距离和初始化学丰度。因此，星团是校准恒星演化模型、研究多体动力学以及示踪银河系结构与形成历史的“天然实验室”。在任何星团研究中，首要且最关键的步骤是区分真正的星团成员星与视线方向上的前景或背景场星（即确定“成员星概率”）。随着欧洲空间局（ESA）Gaia空间望远镜等大规模巡天项目的推进，天文学家获取了海量恒星的高精度天体测量数据（自行、视差）和测光数据，这催生了众多基于运动学、测光特征及机器学习的星团探测与成员星鉴定算法。然而，由于算法设计和假设的不同，不同方法生成的星团星表之间通常无法直接等效替换。
contribution: 本文全面综述了星团成员星判定方法的发展历史，系统比较了主流方法（如空间分布、自行、极大似然、机器学习、贝叶斯和UPMASK等）的统计假设，并分析了这些方法学差异在Gaia实际数据中的具体影响。论文通过三个具体案例分析（主流星表Cantat-Gaudin、Hunt & Reffert与Perren的横向对比；昴星团的天体测量对比；以及统一星团星表UCC中低置信度候选体的审查）指出，星表间的差异主要并非源于Gaia测量误差，而是由于星团定义、星等极限、误差处理及先验假设的不同。研究发现，主流星表在亮星端的成员重合度约为70%至80%，但在暗星端（如G=20）重合度急剧下降至约35%；同时，UCC中部分新发现星团因成员稀疏或缺乏独立验证而被合理地标记为低置信度目标。
summary: Reliable stellar-cluster membership is essential for deriving cluster ages, distances, reddenings, metallicities, mass functions, dynamical parameters, and Galactic-structure tracers. The Gaia era has produced a proliferation of membership and cluster-detection methods, but the resulting catalogues are not interchangeable. We review the historical development of membership assignment, compare the statistical assumptions of major methods, and explicitly examine the practical consequences of methodological choices on real Gaia data. We consider spatial, proper-motion, maximum-likelihood, photometric, UPMASK, density-based, machine-learning, Bayesian, and bootstrap membership approaches. We add three case studies: a direct comparison of \citet{CantatGaudinAnders2020}, \citet{HuntReffert2023}, and \citet{Perren2023} for common clusters; a Pleiades astrometric comparison; and a critical examination of low-trust candidates in the Unified Cluster Catalogue (UCC), including CWNU, CWWDL, and CKCWDM objects. The literature shows that disagreement is not simply a consequence of Gaia measurement errors. Different definitions of a cluster, different magnitude limits, different treatment of uncertainties, different spatial priors, and different tolerances for extended or low-density populations can lead to substantially different member lists. \citet{Perren2023} reported an average member-list overlap of roughly 75--80\% with \citet{CantatGaudinAnders2020} and 70--75\% with \citet{HuntReffert2023} at bright magnitudes, with the HUNT23 overlap decreasing to about 35\% at $G=20$. The UCC also flags many newly reported candidates as low-trust objects when their member distribution is sparse, their literature support is weak, or they have strong duplicate/non-cluster indicators.

title: The quest for high-redshift radio galaxies II. Discovery of the most powerful known radio galaxy at z=4.946
background_knowledge: 高红移射电星系（High-redshift Radio Galaxies, HzRGs）是早期宇宙中一类包含活跃星系核（AGN）的大质量星系，其中心超大质量黑洞的吸积活动驱动了向外延伸的强大相对论性射电喷流。由于其在射电波段极为明亮，天文学家通常结合大面积射电巡天与光学/近红外波段的‘莱曼断裂技术’（Lyman break technique）或特征发射线探测来搜寻这些遥远天体。HzRGs不仅是研究极早期宇宙超大质量黑洞及其喷流物理机制的极端实验室，同时也是示踪早期大尺度结构演化和原星系团形成的重要探针。
contribution: 本研究利用莱曼断裂技术与光学光谱学观测，成功证认了射电源 TXS 2354+015 为一个高红移射电星系。其光学光谱展现出明亮且不对称的莱曼阿尔法（Lyα）发射线（等值宽度约900埃）和 NV λ1640 发射线，从而精确测定其红移为 z=4.946。该星系的宽带射电光谱符合斜率为0.94的幂律分布，其在静止坐标系 500 MHz 频段的射电光度高达 6.2×10^29 W/Hz，标志着该天体是迄今为止已知光度最高、最强大的射电星系。
summary: As part of our quest for high-redshift radio galaxies (HzRGs), we present the results obtained from optical spectroscopy leading to the confirmation of one HzRG candidate selected using the Lyman break technique. The optical emission, associated with the radio source TXS 2354+015, exhibits a prominent drop in the r band, which is characteristic of sources at z~5. The optical spectrum shows a bright asymmetric emission line, with a large equivalent width of ~900 Angstrom. Its identification with the Ly$α$ line is confirmed by the detection of the NV$λ$1640, leading to a redshift estimate of z=4.946. Its broadband radio spectrum is well reproduced using a power law with a slope of 0.94. The radio luminosity at the rest frame frequency of 500 MHz is 6.2e29 W/Hz. This result makes this source the most powerful radio galaxy currently known.

title: Exceptional Gamma-Ray Flaring Activity of the Blazar S4 0954+65 in Early 2025
background_knowledge: 耀变体（Blazar）是一类中心由超大质量黑洞驱动、且其极端相对论性喷流几乎直指地球视线的活动星系核（AGN）。由于多普勒聚束效应，其辐射被大幅增强，常在各个电磁波段表现出剧烈的亮度变化（耀发，Flare）。耀变体的宽带光谱能量分布（SED）通常呈典型的双峰结构：低频峰（覆盖射电至光学/X射线）源于相对论性电子的同步辐射；高频峰（X射线至高能伽马射线）的物理起源存在争议，轻子模型认为是逆康普顿散射（如同步自康普顿SSC，或来自宽线区/尘埃环光子的外部康普顿EC），而强子/轻子-强子混合模型则引入了质子的相互作用。耀变体的剧烈爆发往往与喷流内部的激波加速机制（shock-in-jet）相关，且常常伴随喷流结构的变化（如通过VLBA观测到的新射电结的超光速抛射）。
contribution: 该论文针对耀变体S4 0954+65在2025年初爆发的异常伽马射线高态，开展了涵盖射电至伽马射线的多波段观测与宽带SED建模。研究发现伽马射线光变领先于光学和射电波段，且伽马与X射线均展现出'越亮越硬'的光谱特征，暗示了耀发期间活跃的粒子加速过程。高分辨率VLBA成像揭示了一个新的超光速射电结的喷射，其推算抛射时间与伽马射线峰值高度吻合，在时序和结构演化上强烈支持'喷流内激波'模型。宽带SED建模表明，引入尘埃环种子光子的轻子辐射模型（SSC+EC）能够以物理上合理的参数重现观测结果，而轻子-强子混合模型虽可行但要求极高的喷流总功率。
summary: S4 0954+65 (4FGL J0958.7+6534) is a TeV-detected blazar at a redshift of $z = 0.3694 \pm 0.0011$, classified as an intermediate-synchrotron-peaked BL Lac object. In early 2025, it entered an exceptional $γ$-ray high state. We aim to investigate the origin and physical properties of the exceptional 2025 flare, and to constrain the emission processes responsible for this flaring activity. We performed a multi-wavelength analysis using $γ$-ray, X-ray, optical/UV, radio, and 43 GHz Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA) observations. We examined multi-band correlations with the z-transformed discrete correlation function (zDCF), analyzed the spectral evolution and parsec-scale jet kinematics, and modeled the broadband spectral energy distributions (SEDs). The $γ$-ray variations lead the optical and radio emission by 3.22 days and possibly 18.26 days, respectively, while no significant correlation is found between the $γ$-ray and X-ray emission. The $γ$-ray spectra show a harder-when-brighter behavior, consistent with enhanced particle acceleration during the active state. A similar spectral trend is also observed in the X-ray band, where the photon index is anti-correlated with flux. During the major $γ$-ray flare, VLBA images reveal the emergence of a new superluminal radio knot from the core, whose extrapolated ejection time is consistent with the peak of the $γ$-ray flare. The temporal and structural evolution during the 2025 flare is consistent with a shock-in-jet scenario, in which a newly emerging disturbance propagates downstream and drives the flare. Broadband SED modeling shows that a leptonic synchrotron self-Compton plus external Compton model with dusty torus seed photons reproduces the multi-wavelength observations with physically plausible parameters. A lepto-hadronic interpretation remains possible but requires substantially higher jet power.

title: Binary-pulsar Timing: A 3D Solar-System Accelerometer and Unknown-Source Probe
background_knowledge: 太阳系质心（SSB）在银河系引力势中运动，其加速度不仅反映了银河系的宏观质量分布，也对太阳系局部的微观引力环境极为敏感。如果太阳系附近存在未知的暗天体（如假设中的‘第九大行星’或游荡的原初黑洞），它们会对SSB产生额外的微小引力扰动。双星脉冲星由于具有极其稳定的自转和轨道周期，被视为宇宙中最精确的天然时钟。当太阳系质心发生微小的加速运动时，这种运动会通过多普勒效应等运动学效应在脉冲星信号的到达时间（Pulsar Timing）中留下特征印记。因此，通过对多颗脉冲星计时信号的联合分析，可以反推太阳系质心的三维加速度，从而将脉冲星网络转化为高精度的‘宇宙加速度计’，用于探测局部引力环境和限制未知暗源。
contribution: 本研究开发了一种基于双星脉冲星计时的分析框架，结合26颗双星脉冲星的视线差分加速度，成功联合重建了太阳系质心（SSB）的三维加速度。结果显示，在扣除三种平滑的银河系势能基线后，残余加速度与零一致。研究在50%、75%和全天区方向上分别给出了0.198、0.262和0.693 μas/yr的95%置信度上限，这些限制比Gaia EDR3基准严格了1.6至3.6倍，比之前的脉冲星限制提高了一个多数量级。此外，研究将框架扩展至包含SSB与脉冲星的双端响应，实现了对未知引力源依赖于空间位置的直接质量限制（例如排除了0.21至0.39秒差距内存在10倍太阳质量天体的可能性），在距离大于0.2秒差距的区域，其限制能力超越了现有星历表（INPOP19a）基准约一个数量级。
summary: The acceleration of the Solar System barycenter (SSB) offers a unique precision probe of the local gravitational environment, enabling searches for otherwise invisible gravitating sources such as Planet Nine and nearby (primordial) black holes. Using the binary-pulsar timing measurements, we develop an analysis framework that combines the line-of-sight differential accelerations of 26 binary pulsars to jointly reconstruct the three-dimensional acceleration of the SSB and place directional upper limits. Across three smooth Galactic-potential baselines, the residual acceleration is consistent with zero. We obtain directional 95\% upper limits of $0.198$, $0.262$, and $0.693~μ\mathrm{as}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}$ over 50\%, 75\%, and all sampled directions, respectively. These limits are tighter by factors of 3.5, 3.6, and 1.6 than a matched Gaia EDR3 benchmark and improve previous pulsar constraints by more than an order of magnitude. We further extend the framework to the full SSB--pulsar two-endpoint response, enabling direct position-dependent mass constraints on unknown gravitational sources. A $10\,M_\odot$ object is excluded within 0.39, 0.34, and 0.21 pc over the same sky fractions. Our unknown-mass limits surpass the tidal-equivalent INPOP19a reference beyond 0.2 pc by about an order of magnitude over most of the sky at 1 pc.

title: VLTI/MATISSE observations of the hot dust around $β$ Pictoris: Observing faint objects with MATISSE
background_knowledge: 系外黄道尘（Exozodiacal dust）是存在于主序星周围、类似太阳系黄道尘的高温尘埃物质，通常分布在距离恒星非常近的区域（如几个天文单位以内，靠近尘埃升华半径）。这些尘埃被认为是行星系统演化过程中，小天体（如小行星）碰撞或系外彗星（exocomets）活动所产生的碎屑。绘架座 $\beta$（$\beta$ Pictoris）是一个标志性的年轻行星系统，拥有已知的系外行星和丰富的碎屑盘结构。然而，由于热尘埃非常靠近明亮的中心恒星且辐射相对微弱，对其空间分布和颗粒物理性质的直接空间解析观测极具挑战，通常需要依赖极高空间分辨率的光学/红外长基线干涉测量技术（如欧洲南方天文台的甚大望远镜干涉仪 VLTI）来提取微弱的星周辐射信号。
contribution: 本文利用 VLTI/MATISSE 仪器在 L 波段（约 3.5 微米）对绘架座 $\beta$ 进行了高分辨率干涉观测。研究团队开发了一种通过评估完整数据协方差矩阵来处理干涉测量相关性的新方法，并发现考虑该相关性对推断尘埃性质具有重大影响。数据建模揭示了在恒星尘埃升华半径附近存在一个致密（约 0.05 天文单位）、大倾角的热尘埃结构，该结构主要由亚微米级颗粒组成，贡献了 3.4 微米处约 4%-7.5% 的总通量。值得注意的是，该内部热尘埃结构与已知的外部边缘碎屑盘在天空平面上存在约 60 度的显著空间错位。这一结果为存在了二十年的‘热系外黄道尘位于升华半径附近且由亚微米颗粒组成’的理论范式提供了坚实的观测支持，且其与外盘的错位进一步印证了这些热尘埃与系外彗星活动之间的动力学联系。
summary: Context: Hot exozodiacal dust has been detected around approximately 20% of nearby main-sequence stars, indicating that it is a common feature of extrasolar planetary systems. However, its spatial distribution and grain properties remain poorly understood. Aims: We aim to show that the spatial distribution of hot dust around beta Pictoris, an iconic planetary system with two known planets and a population of exocomets, can be constrained through a detailed analysis of optical long-baseline interferometry data. Methods: We obtained L-band observations at approximately 3.5 microns of beta Pictoris with MATISSE at the VLTI. We developed a method to assess correlations in the visibility measurements by estimating the full data covariance matrix, and modeled the circumstellar emission with geometric brightness distributions. Results: We detect circumstellar emission around beta Pictoris consistent with hot exozodiacal dust. Modeling the emission with and without accounting for data correlations demonstrates their significant impact on the inferred dust properties. The best-fit model reveals a compact (approximately 0.05 au), highly inclined dust structure near the sublimation radius, misaligned by approximately 60 degrees on the sky with respect to the extended edge-on outer disk. It contributes approximately 4%-7.5% of the total flux at 3.4 microns and is composed of submicron-sized grains. The data are also compatible with an additional dust component near 1 au. Conclusions: For beta Pictoris, the two-decade-old paradigm placing hot exozodiacal dust near the sublimation radius and consisting of submicron-sized grains finds observational support in the detailed analysis of MATISSE data. The misalignment with the known debris disk further supports a link to exocometary activity.

title: Spatial segregation as the origin of anisotropic satellite quenching in haloes and beyond
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化领域中，大质量暗物质晕通常包含一个位于中心的中央星系以及多个围绕其运行的卫星星系。卫星星系在绕行过程中，受星系际介质的冲压剥离（ram pressure stripping）、潮汐作用等环境效应影响，其恒星形成活动往往会逐渐停止，这一过程被称为星系的‘猝灭’（quenching）。近年来的观测发现，卫星星系的猝灭在空间分布上存在显著的各向异性：位于中央星系长轴方向上的卫星星系具有更高的猝灭比例。由于活动星系核（AGN）的喷流通常倾向于沿短轴方向爆发，人们曾猜测AGN反馈等内部物理过程可能在其中扮演了重要角色。关于这种猝灭各向异性的真正物理起源（是源于反馈机制、动力学演化还是大尺度环境），一直是该领域亟待阐明的重要前沿问题。
contribution: 本文利用SIMBA、TNG100、EAGLE以及无反馈机制的SIMBA宇宙学流体动力学模拟（在z=0时刻），揭示了卫星星系各向异性猝灭的主要起源是猝灭星系与未猝灭星系在空间上的偏析（spatial segregation）。研究发现：猝灭的卫星星系在空间上更集中于晕中心，且更强烈地沿中央星系的长轴对齐；而未猝灭的卫星星系分布在更大的半径上，且趋于各向同性。由于这种现象在关闭了恒星与AGN反馈的模拟中依然存在，表明反馈机制对卫星星系的各向异性猝灭并不起决定性作用。此外，在暗物质晕边界之外的大尺度上，该猝灭信号与长轴方向上星系数量的过剩密切相关，这将其与星系群、星系团及宇宙网纤维结构的方向依赖性分布联系了起来。该研究为晕内及超晕尺度的卫星星系各向异性猝灭提供了一个统一的几何解释框架。
summary: Satellite galaxies in massive halos are seen to be preferentially quenched along the major axes of their central galaxies. In contrast, the AGN jet tends to point along the minor axis, which imposes interesting constraints on the role of AGN feedback in satellite galaxy quenching. Here we use the SIMBA, TNG100, EAGLE, and feedback-free SIMBA cosmological simulations at $z=0$ to show that this satellite anisotropy primarily originates from spatial segregation between quenched and unquenched populations. Quenched satellites are more centrally concentrated and more strongly aligned with the central galaxy's major axis, whereas unquenched satellites occupy larger radii and are more nearly isotropic. The persistence of this behaviour without stellar or active galactic nucleus feedback suggests that feedback is not important for satellite quenching. Beyond the halo boundary, the signal varies strongly among simulations and correlates with the excess number of galaxies along the major axis. This links large-scale anisotropic quenching to the direction-dependent distribution of groups, clusters and filamentary environments. Our results provide a unified geometrical interpretation of anisotropic satellite quenching across halo and extra-halo scales.

title: Heavy Higgsino Dark Matter at the Scale of the Vanishing Higgs Quartic
background_knowledge: 在粒子物理标准模型中，希格斯场的四次耦合常数（Higgs quartic coupling）会随着能量尺度的升高而发生‘跑动’（running）。当前观测数据推断，该常数在极高能标（约$10^9-10^{12}$ GeV）处趋于零，这暗示了该能标处可能存在新物理（如超对称理论）的紫外边界条件。超对称理论（SUSY）是标准模型的自然扩展，其中最轻的超对称粒子（如希格斯微子，Higgsino）是极佳的暗物质候选者。通常暗物质的遗迹丰度通过‘冻结’（freeze-out）机制解释，但对于极高质量的暗物质粒子，由于其湮灭截面等特性，传统的冻结机制往往失效，此时通常需要引入‘冻入’（freeze-in）机制——即暗物质从未在早期宇宙中达到热平衡，而是通过重加热阶段等离子体中粒子的碰撞缓慢产生。诸如LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) 等暗物质直接探测实验，正在不断缩小和检验这些理论模型的参数空间。
contribution: 论文提出了一种高质量希格斯微子（Higgsino）暗物质模型，揭示了直接探测实验所要求的高质量下限（约$10^{11}$ GeV）与标准模型中希格斯四次耦合趋于零的能标之间存在的深刻物理联系。研究指出，在此类高能标超对称模型中，当Higgsino质量高于宇宙重加热温度时，可以通过玻尔兹曼压低的‘冻入机制’成功重现当前观测到的暗物质遗迹丰度。该工作不仅将暗物质的质量与实验测定的希格斯质量联系起来，明确其参数空间已被LZ实验有效限制，并将被未来的DARWIN/XLZD实验决定性地检验；此外，论文还探讨了PeV量级的Higgsino与$10^7$ GeV马约拉纳规范微子共存的情况，为LZ实验中的潜在信号提供了一种非弹性散射的理论解释。
summary: The Standard Model Higgs quartic coupling runs to zero around $10^9-10^{12}$ GeV at $2σ$, suggestive of an ultraviolet boundary condition $λ\simeq0$ at this scale. In a well-motivated class of high-scale supersymmetric (SUSY) models, the quartic is automatically set to zero at tree level at the superpartner scale. The Higgsino can naturally emerge as the lightest SUSY particle, with its two neutral Weyl components sufficiently degenerate to form an effectively Dirac fermion with an unsuppressed vector coupling to the $Z$. For such Higgsino dark matter, direct detection requires a mass above $\sim10^{11}$ GeV, leading to a coincidence with the scale independently selected by the vanishing quartic. Such a heavy Higgsino cannot freeze out with the observed relic density. However, if its mass exceeds the reheating temperature, the observed dark matter abundance can be reproduced through Boltzmann suppressed freeze-in. This scenario connects the dark matter mass to the measured Higgs mass, with a parameter space already constrained by LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) and which will be decisively tested at DARWIN/XLZD. Finally, we consider PeV Higgsinos with Majorana gauginos of order $10^7$ GeV, permitting an inelastic Higgsino interpretation of the tentative LZ event while retaining the connection between the scalar superpartner scale and the vanishing Higgs quartic scale.

title: The shell around VY Canis Majoris in SPHEREx is likely an artifact
background_knowledge: 大犬座VY（VY Canis Majoris）是银河系中已知体积最大且光度最高的红特超巨星之一。处于恒星演化晚期的特超巨星通常伴随极端的质量流失，抛射出的物质会在恒星周围形成广延的星际尘埃与气体包层（即星周壳层）。在天文空间望远镜（如SPHEREx任务）的实际观测中，当视场内存在这类极其明亮的光源时，光学系统的内部反射或散射极易在探测器上产生光晕、鬼影等仪器假象（Artifacts）。这些假象在形态上往往与真实的星周物理结构高度相似，因此在分析明亮天体周围的延展结构时，必须首先排除探测器系统性误差的干扰。
contribution: 本文对近期一项基于SPHEREx任务图像报道大犬座VY周围存在巨大壳层结构的研究提出了质疑。研究团队通过分析SPHEREx波段1（Band 1）的图像数据，发现在该探测器的相似位置上，其他明亮恒星周围也出现了同类的壳层特征。这一证据表明，此前在大犬座VY周围观测到的所谓“壳层”并非真实的物理结构，而是探测器产生的光学假象。
summary: Recently, the presence of a large shell around the bright hypergiant star VY Canis Majoris was reported in images from the SPHEREx mission. We report similar shells around other bright stars at similar locations in SPHEREx Band 1 images, suggesting that this shell is not astrophysical but instead a detector artifact.

title: The JWST and ALMA view of local dwarf Pox 186: Evidence of stripped binaries driving a hard radiation field and little cold molecular gas resulting in high star-formation efficiency
background_knowledge: 宇宙再电离时期（Reionization era）的早期星系对宇宙演化至关重要，但受限于观测距离，直接解析其内部物理细节极其困难。因此，天文学家常选取具有极端紫外与远红外辐射性质的“近邻矮星系（Local dwarf galaxies）”作为高红移星系的“本地替代样本（Local analogs）”进行高分辨率研究。在星系星际介质（ISM）与恒星形成的诊断中，中红外（MIR）波段的精细结构谱线比（如氖[Ne]和硫[S]的离子线）是衡量星系内部辐射场硬度与甄别电离源性质（如大质量恒星、双星系统或活动星系核AGN）的关键工具；而中红外氢分子（H2）和亚毫米波一氧化碳（CO）谱线则是探究温、冷分子气体储量及恒星形成效率（SFE）的核心探针。JWST与ALMA的协同观测，为全面揭示此类星系的辐射机制与气体转化过程提供了前所未有的观测能力。
contribution: 本研究利用JWST（中红外MIRI仪器）与ALMA观测了再电离期星系的典型近邻替代样本——矮星系Pox 186。基于中红外谱线比（[NeIII]/[NeII]与[SIV]/[SIII]）的“柔软度图”证实该星系存在极硬的辐射场。光致电离模型揭示，被剥离包层的双星系统（stripped binary stars）是驱动该极端中红外谱线特征的主要电离源，而年轻星暴则主导了中红外尘埃连续谱。此外，结合H2与CO谱线的分析表明该星系冷分子气体稀缺，呈现出与再电离期星系相似的极高恒星形成效率（> 15×10^-9 yr^-1）与极短的气体耗尽时间。该成果确证了主导Pox 186硬辐射场的是恒星形成活动而非AGN，并提示在判定高红移星系的物理本质时不能仅依赖单纯的紫外波段诊断。
summary: We present a JWST mid-infrared (MIR) view of Pox 186, one of the best local analogs of reionization-era galaxies based on its extreme properties in the ultraviolet, optical, and far-infrared (FIR). We extracted a high signal-to-noise spectrum of Pox 186 from the spatially resolved MIR data taken with the Medium Resolution Spectrometer (MRS) on the MIR Instrument (MIRI), and compared its MIR properties with those of the other dwarf galaxies in the Herschel Dwarf Galaxy Survey. We probe the radiation hardness of Pox 186 using the so-called softness diagram, based on the MIR line ratios [NeIII]/[NeII] and [SIV]/[SIII], which suggest that Pox 186 hosts ionization sources with a hard radiation field. We probe the dominant ionization source in Pox 186 using diagnostic diagrams based on MIR line ratios. Our photoionization models provide evidence that stripped binary stars are the main cause of the extreme MIR line ratios. Similarly, a young starburst is needed to reproduce the MIR dust continuum. We probe the warm and cold molecular gas content using the MIR H$_2$ rotational lines (S(1)-S(7)) from JWST, and the archival sub-mm CO(2-1) line from ALMA, which indicate a high star-formation efficiency (SFE; $>$ 15 $\times$ 10$^{-9}$ yr$^{-1}$) and low gas depletion time comparable to that of the reionization-era galaxies. This analysis strongly suggests that star formation rather than active galactic nuclei drives the hard radiation field observed in Pox 186, and cautions against relying solely on the UV diagnostics to establish the nature of high-z galaxies.

title: Environmental Imprints of Dark Matter and Accretion Disks on Eccentric EMRIs around Kerr Black Holes
background_knowledge: 极端质量比旋入（EMRI）是指恒星级致密天体（如恒星级黑洞或中子星）旋入超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的双星系统。这类系统是未来空间引力波干涉仪（如LISA、太极、天琴等）的核心探测目标。由于小天体在SMBH的强引力场中经历数万次极轨旋入，其释放的低频引力波波形对黑洞时空几何极为敏感。在真实的宇宙学环境中，超大质量黑洞并非处于纯粹的真空中，其周围通常包裹着暗物质晕（在黑洞附近可能形成高密度的暗物质“尖峰”）以及由重子物质组成的吸积盘。这些复杂的星系核环境会通过动力学摩擦、吸积盘力矩及引力势扰动等机制对旋入天体施加作用力，导致引力波波形相对于真空模型产生相位偏移（Dephasing）。提取并识别这些环境印记，不仅有助于精确测量黑洞参数，还能为探测暗物质属性和吸积盘物理提供独特的引力波探针。
contribution: 本研究针对克尔黑洞周围的赤道偏心EMRI系统，定量评估了暗物质（DM）尖峰与吸积盘对其引力波波形的联合影响。作者将暗物质动力学摩擦、暗物质自身引力、牛顿吸积盘力矩和吸积盘自身引力这四种效应整合到五阶后牛顿（5PN）增强分析近似（AAK）波形模型中，并利用Fisher矩阵分析了参数的可测性。研究发现：当主黑洞质量约为10^6太阳质量时，由暗物质动力学摩擦引起的退相干最强（可达10^2-10^3弧度），此时DM尖峰的密度斜率可以被测量至亚百分比精度，且如果忽略DM效应会严重导致内禀参数的估计偏差；当主黑洞质量大于10^8太阳质量时，DM与吸积盘的自身引力效应占主导。此外，联合分析揭示了吸积盘参数之间具有强烈的简并性，且DM斜率与吸积盘参数之间存在跨扇区的物理简并，提出打破这种简并以独立测量吸积盘参数需要依赖更先进的相对论力矩模型或结合电磁对应体观测。
summary: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), systems in which a stellar-mass compact object spirals into a supermassive black hole ($M_1$), are prime targets for the space-based gravitational-wave interferometers and are acutely sensitive to their astrophysical environment. We quantify the joint imprint of a dark matter (DM) spike and an accretion disk on the waveforms of eccentric, equatorial Kerr EMRIs, integrating four modular effects---DM dynamical friction, DM self-gravity, Newtonian accretion-disk torques, and disk self-gravity---into a fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) augmented analytic kludge (AAK) waveform model, and assess their measurability via a Fisher-matrix analysis. The DM dynamical-friction dephasing peaks at $M_1\sim 10^6\,M_\odot$, reaching $\sim 10^2$--$10^3\,\mathrm{rad}$; there the DM spike slope is measurable to sub-percent precision and both DM channels are unambiguously detectable, while omitting DM biases the intrinsic parameters significantly. At $M_1\gtrsim 10^8\,M_\odot$ the DM and disk self-gravity channels dominate their dissipative counterparts. The disk parameters remain degenerate across the explored parameter space, since the supersonic regime dominates the inspiral and the subsonic-to-supersonic transition only mildly weakens this degeneracy without lifting it; a combined DM$+$disk analysis further reveals a cross-sector degeneracy between the DM slope and the disk parameters. This physical degeneracy, reflected in the near-singular Fisher matrix, implies that independently measuring the disk parameters requires a relativistic torque model or an electromagnetic counterpart.

title: Igniting Galaxy Formation in the Postreionization Universe, II: Nature versus Nurture
background_knowledge: 宇宙再电离（Reionization）是早期宇宙演化的重要阶段。在这一时期，第一代恒星和星系产生的强烈紫外辐射（紫外背景）电离了星系际介质中的中性氢。这种强烈的辐射场会对小质量暗物质晕产生负反馈作用，通过加热气体使其难以冷却坍缩，从而阻碍或抑制矮星系的恒星形成。然而，在再电离结束后的宇宙中，仍有部分富含气体的暗物质晕能够克服这种抑制，成功“点燃”恒星形成。探究决定这些小质量暗物质晕能否开启恒星形成的决定性因素——究竟是取决于其所处的宇宙大尺度环境（“后天培育”，Nurture），还是晕本身的内在物理属性（“先天性质”，Nature），是星系形成与演化领域的重要前沿课题。
contribution: 本研究利用FIREbox宇宙学流体动力学模拟，对比了在红移 z=2-6 期间近期“点燃”恒星形成的暗物质晕与无恒星形成的暗物质晕。通过机器学习分类测试环境因素与内在属性的影响，研究发现，暗物质晕所处的几何环境（宇宙网位置）对是否开启恒星形成影响甚微；相反，暗物质晕自身的内在中性气体储库特征（如总中性氢质量、中性气体分布范围以及中心中性氢密度）是最核心的决定因素。此外，研究指出无星晕中的气体随时间推移并未耗尽，而是逐渐被电离，导致恒星形成的“点火窗口”在 z ≃ 2 以下关闭。该工作明确论证了在早期星系恒星形成的触发机制上，“先天性质”（内在气体属性）胜于“后天培育”（外部环境）。
summary: Although the ultraviolet background from reionization is thought to conspire against the smallest halos, some gas-rich halos in the post-reionization Universe still form stars. We ask which properties, environmental or intrinsic, determine ignition. Using the FIREbox cosmological volume, we compare recently-ignited halos to a mass- and gas-matched sample of gas-resolved starless halos at $z=2$--6. We test three families of "third axis" properties beyond $M_{\rm vir}$, $M_{\rm gas}$, and $z$: geometric environment (the Perturbation Index and local galaxy density $ρ_5$), hydrodynamic environment (the $1$--$2,R_{\rm vir}$ gas-supply shell), and intrinsic halo properties (concentration and the neutral-gas reservoir). A nested random-forest classification finds that geometric environment adds little, while the hydrodynamic shell is modestly informative. Three complementary properties each discriminate ignited from starless halos beyond the mass--gas--redshift baseline (AUC $=0.635$, where $0.5$ is chance): total HI mass ($M_{\rm HI}$, AUC $=0.739$), the extent of the neutral gas ($r_{\rm HI,50}/R_{\rm vir}$, AUC $=0.738$), and the central HI density ($ρ_{\rm HI,0}$, AUC $=0.700$); jointly they reach AUC $=0.823$, the highest of any combination we test. At fixed halo mass, gas mass and redshift, recently-ignited halos harbor more HI over a larger radius than their matched controls, and these two enhancements are uncorrelated. The same reservoir sets when ignition can happen: from $z=6$ to $z=0$ the median starless halo keeps its gas ($+0.05$ dex) while its neutral fraction falls by $3.9$ dex, so the reservoir is ionized rather than exhausted and the ignition window closes below $z\simeq2$. In sum, a halo's own neutral-gas reservoir discriminates ignited from starless halos more sharply than its location in the cosmic web -- nature over nurture.
